introVariants.en: Custom connector leads and harness assemblies defined around specified TE / AMP interfaces, terminal systems, wire, sealing and installation requirements.
introVariants.zh: 围绕指定 TE / AMP 接口、端子系统、线材、密封与安装要求，开发定制连接线和线束组件。

introVariants.en: A brand or housing shape is not an interchangeability specification. Confirm the complete mating system and approved bill of materials.
introVariants.zh: 品牌名称或壳体外形不是互换规格，需要确认完整对插系统及认可物料清单。

text.zh: 识别设备端完整接口，再确定线封、空孔和出线方向。
text.en: Identify the full equipment interface before defining wire seals, unused cavities and cable exits.

text.zh: 按供电、信号及接地回路分别确定壳体、端子与线径。
text.en: Define housings, contacts and wire sizes separately for power, signal and grounding circuits.

text.zh: 将安装孔位、后方操作空间和两端腔位视图纳入组件图纸。
text.en: Include mounting positions, rear access and both cavity views in the assembly drawing.

text.zh: 继电器与快接端可按项目需求评审。按具体系列核对对插图、键位和接口方向。
text.en: For relay and quick-disconnect positions, review the project conditions. Check mating drawings, keying and orientation for the exact series.

text.zh: 机箱穿板连接可按项目需求评审。用端子应用文件确定导体范围、绝缘支撑与压接工装。
text.en: For enclosure through-panel connections, review the project conditions. Use contact application documents to define conductor range, insulation support and crimp tooling.

text.zh: 设备检修转接端可按项目需求评审。指定物料与拟议替代分别列入认可清单。
text.en: For equipment service-adapter ends, review the project conditions. List specified components and proposed alternatives separately in the approved BOM.

title.en: Check the interface and matching parts

text.zh: 同时记录壳体、端子、线封与二次锁的完整料号。 AMP家族名称不能确定具体插合系统。
text.en: Record full part numbers for housings, contacts, seals and secondary locks. The AMP family name does not identify a mating system.

text.zh: 按具体系列核对对插图、键位和接口方向。 相同孔数不证明端子与密封件匹配。
text.en: Check mating drawings, keying and orientation for the exact series. Equal cavity count does not establish terminal/seal fit.

text.zh: 用端子应用文件确定导体范围、绝缘支撑与压接工装。 原厂来源或授权需文件验证。
text.en: Use contact application documents to define conductor range, insulation support and crimp tooling. Original source or authorization requires document verification.

value.zh: 请提供完整料号、对插图纸、腔位定义、线径与绝缘外径、使用环境、数量及检验要求。

label.en: Sample and release basis

value.en: Review parts and tooling, approve first articles, then produce against controlled drawings and the agreed inspection plan.
value.zh: 审核物料与工装，完成首件认可后，按受控图纸和约定检验计划生产。

question.zh: AMP名称能直接确定对插件吗？
question.en: Does the AMP name identify the mating connector?

answer.zh: AMP家族名称不能确定具体插合系统。同时记录壳体、端子、线封与二次锁的完整料号。
answer.en: The AMP family name does not identify a mating system. Record full part numbers for housings, contacts, seals and secondary locks.

question.zh: 孔数一样就能使用同一组端子吗？
question.en: Do equal cavity counts mean the contacts are interchangeable?

answer.zh: 相同孔数不证明端子与密封件匹配。按具体系列核对对插图、键位和接口方向。
answer.en: Equal cavity count does not establish terminal/seal fit. Check mating drawings, keying and orientation for the exact series.

question.zh: 如何确定原厂件或替代件的供货范围？
question.en: How is the supply scope for original or alternative parts defined?

answer.zh: 原厂来源或授权需文件验证。用端子应用文件确定导体范围、绝缘支撑与压接工装。
answer.en: Original source or authorization requires document verification. Use contact application documents to define conductor range, insulation support and crimp tooling.

avoidMisidentification.en: The AMP family name does not identify a mating system

introVariants.en: Custom wire-to-board, wire-to-wire and equipment cable assemblies built around specified Molex interfaces, with defined circuits, materials and inspection requirements.
introVariants.zh: 围绕指定 Molex 接口开发线对板、线对线及设备电缆组件，明确回路、材料与检验要求。

introVariants.en: Molex is a manufacturer, not one plug size. Family, mating geometry, terminal and electrical duty must be identified together.
introVariants.zh: Molex 是制造商名称，不是一种插头尺寸。系列、对插几何、端子及电气工况需要一起识别。

text.zh: 先确定线对板或线对线形式，再核对极化与插拔空间。
text.en: Define wire-to-board or wire-to-wire construction before checking polarization and mating access.

text.zh: 同时加载的回路数、环境温度与导体规格共同影响选型。
text.en: Loaded circuit count, ambient temperature and conductor specification guide selection together.

text.zh: 将两端系列与连接表分开记录，避免外观相近接头混配。
text.en: Record each end and its connection table separately to prevent mixing similar-looking interfaces.

text.zh: 电源模块端可按项目需求评审。接点公母、材料与镀层按具体端子文件配套。
text.en: For power-module ends, review the project conditions. Match contact gender, material and plating to the specific contact documents.

text.zh: 风扇与辅助模块端可按项目需求评审。核对防误插、卡扣和操作空间，而不只看间距。
text.en: For fan and auxiliary-module ends, review the project conditions. Check polarization, latch and access rather than pitch alone.

text.zh: 电器面板引线可按项目需求评审。按实际多路负载和安装温度审核电流与导体。
text.en: For appliance panel leads, review the project conditions. Review current and conductors against actual multi-circuit loading and installed temperature.

title.en: Check the interface and matching parts

text.zh: 提供系列名称及壳体、对插端完整料号。 近似外形系列不可默认互换。
text.en: Provide the series and full housing and mating-part numbers. Do not assume interchangeability between similar-looking series.

text.zh: 接点公母、材料与镀层按具体端子文件配套。 针数相同不代表极化相同。
text.en: Match contact gender, material and plating to the specific contact documents. Equal pin count does not establish equal polarization.

text.zh: 核对防误插、卡扣和操作空间，而不只看间距。 单接点额定与整壳多路负载分别核对。
text.en: Check polarization, latch and access rather than pitch alone. Review single-contact ratings separately from loaded multiposition housings.

label.en: Exact Molex series and housing part number

value.en: Provide the series and full housing and mating-part numbers.

value.en: Check polarization, latch and access rather than pitch alone.

label.en: Contact current, wire size and temperature-derating evidence

value.zh: 按实际多路负载和安装温度审核电流与导体。
value.en: Review current and conductors against actual multi-circuit loading and installed temperature.

label.zh: 安装与使用边界
label.en: Installation and operating boundary

value.en: Provide full mating references, cavity views, circuit table, wire specification, dimensions, routing conditions and order quantities.
value.zh: 请提供完整对插型号、腔位视图、接线表、线材规格、尺寸、布线条件与订购数量。

label.zh: 样品与放行依据
label.en: Sample and release basis

value.en: Confirm the BOM and interface, approve the sample and test plan, then release controlled assembly and agreed verification.
value.zh: 确认物料与接口，认可样品及测试计划后，执行受控装配与约定验证。

question.zh: 外形接近的Molex系列能互换吗？
question.en: Can similar-looking Molex families be interchanged?

answer.zh: 近似外形系列不可默认互换。提供系列名称及壳体、对插端完整料号。
answer.en: Do not assume interchangeability between similar-looking series. Provide the series and full housing and mating-part numbers.

question.zh: 针数相同为什么还要核对极化？
question.en: Why check polarization when the position count matches?

answer.zh: 针数相同不代表极化相同。接点公母、材料与镀层按具体端子文件配套。
answer.en: Equal pin count does not establish equal polarization. Match contact gender, material and plating to the specific contact documents.

question.zh: 单接点额定能直接作为整条线束额定吗？
question.en: Can a single-contact rating define the complete harness rating?

answer.zh: 单接点额定与整壳多路负载分别核对。核对防误插、卡扣和操作空间，而不只看间距。
answer.en: Review single-contact ratings separately from loaded multiposition housings. Check polarization, latch and access rather than pitch alone.

avoidMisidentification.en: Equal pin count does not establish equal polarization

avoidMisidentification.en: Review single-contact ratings separately from loaded multiposition housings

introVariants.en: Custom JST-interface wiring for compact electronics, sensors, equipment and lighting, with series identification, defined pinouts and application-specific materials.
introVariants.zh: 面向紧凑电子、传感器、设备与照明的 JST 接口定制配线，明确系列、针脚定义及适用材料。

introVariants.en: JST identifies a manufacturer, not a universal plug. PH, XH, SH, GH, SM and JWPF differ in pitch, mating geometry and application limits.
introVariants.zh: JST 是制造商名称，不是通用插头。PH、XH、SH、GH、SM 和 JWPF 的间距、对插几何及应用限制各不相同。

text.zh: 按实际板端系列、出线方向和盖板净空安排线长。
text.en: Set lead length around the actual board series, cable exit and enclosure clearance.

text.zh: 细线的绝缘外径、剥皮和端子支撑需要一起确认。
text.en: Confirm fine-wire insulation diameter, stripping and terminal support together.

text.zh: 两端接头可分别定义，导通表按针位视图绘制。
text.en: Define each connector independently and draw the connection table from the cavity views.

text.zh: 小型显示模块端可按项目需求评审。以图纸尺寸核对节距、排数与插合方向。
text.en: For compact display-module ends, review the project conditions. Verify pitch, row count and mating direction from drawings.

text.zh: 便携设备电源端可按项目需求评审。细线导体与绝缘外径均须落入端子加工范围。
text.en: For portable-equipment power ends, review the project conditions. Both conductor size and insulation diameter must fit the contact processing range.

text.zh: 微型执行模块端可按项目需求评审。用实际板端或线端对插件确认锁止和插接空间。
text.en: For miniature actuator-module ends, review the project conditions. Use the actual header or mating lead to check locking and mating space.

title.en: Check the interface and matching parts

text.zh: 保留完整系列、壳体与端子组合，避免仅用间距俗称。 不能以常见间距俗称代替完整系列。
text.en: Retain the full series, housing and contact combination rather than a pitch nickname. Do not replace the full series with a common pitch nickname.

text.zh: 以图纸尺寸核对节距、排数与插合方向。 仿形外壳不等于原厂或完全互换。
text.en: Verify pitch, row count and mating direction from drawings. Look-alike housings do not establish original source or full interchangeability.

text.zh: 细线导体与绝缘外径均须落入端子加工范围。 微型端子需匹配导体与绝缘外径。
text.en: Both conductor size and insulation diameter must fit the contact processing range. Match miniature contacts to conductor and insulation diameter.

value.en: Use the actual header or mating lead to check locking and mating space.

label.en: Installation and operating boundary

value.en: Send the mating part number, cavity view, circuit list, wire size, lengths, environmental conditions and required verification.
value.zh: 请提供对插件型号、腔位视图、回路表、线径、长度、环境条件和所需验证。

label.zh: 样品与放行依据
label.en: Sample and release basis

value.en: Review the interface and BOM, confirm the first article, then manufacture and inspect against the approved documents.
value.zh: 审核接口及物料，确认首件后按认可文件制造与检验。

question.zh: 只写JST和间距可以报价吗？
question.en: Is a JST name and pitch enough for a quotation?

answer.zh: 不能以常见间距俗称代替完整系列。保留完整系列、壳体与端子组合，避免仅用间距俗称。
answer.en: Do not replace the full series with a common pitch nickname. Retain the full series, housing and contact combination rather than a pitch nickname.

question.zh: 相似外壳可以证明完全互换吗？
question.en: Does a similar housing establish full interchangeability?

answer.zh: 仿形外壳不等于原厂或完全互换。以图纸尺寸核对节距、排数与插合方向。
answer.en: Look-alike housings do not establish original source or full interchangeability. Verify pitch, row count and mating direction from drawings.

question.zh: 微型端子为什么同时检查线径和外径？
question.en: Why check conductor size and insulation diameter for miniature contacts?

answer.zh: 微型端子需匹配导体与绝缘外径。细线导体与绝缘外径均须落入端子加工范围。
answer.en: Match miniature contacts to conductor and insulation diameter. Both conductor size and insulation diameter must fit the contact processing range.

introVariants.en: Application-specific DEUTSCH-interface harnesses for equipment and vehicle wiring, with matched housings, contacts, seals, branch layouts and inspection requirements.
introVariants.zh: 面向设备与车辆配线的 DEUTSCH 接口定制线束，成套匹配胶壳、端子、密封件、分支布局与检验要求。

introVariants.en: DT, DTM and DTP use different contact sizes. Circular HDP20/HD30 and single-pole DTHD also require exact identification.
introVariants.zh: DT、DTM 与 DTP 使用不同接点规格，圆形 HDP20／HD30 和单极 DTHD 同样需要准确识别。

text.zh: 结合泥水暴露、检修空间与固定点确定密封和出线布置。
text.en: Define sealing and cable exits around splash exposure, service access and mounting points.

text.zh: 每个支路记录接点尺寸、腔位分配与未使用孔处理。
text.en: Record contact size, cavity assignment and unused-position treatment for every branch.

text.zh: 按原设备对插件逐端核对系列和键位，保留检修余量。
text.en: Check series and keying against each equipment mate and allow service length.

text.zh: 移动机械控制端可按项目需求评审。针孔、公母、键位与腔位视图按对插图确认。
text.en: For mobile-machinery control ends, review the project conditions. Confirm pin/socket arrangement, gender, keying and cavity views against mating drawings.

text.zh: 发动机传感器端可按项目需求评审。线封按绝缘外径选择，未使用腔位的封堵单列。
text.en: For engine sensor ends, review the project conditions. Select seals by insulation diameter and document unused-cavity plugs separately.

text.zh: 设备隔板连接端可按项目需求评审。确定楔形锁装配顺序及端子保持检查点。
text.en: For equipment bulkhead connections, review the project conditions. Define wedge-lock assembly order and contact-retention inspection points.

title.en: Check the interface and matching parts

text.zh: 分别识别DT、DTM、DTP等具体系列及接点尺寸。 DT、DTM和DTP等系列不得按照片混认。
text.en: Identify the exact family, such as DT, DTM or DTP, and its contact size. Do not identify DT, DTM and DTP interchangeably from photos.

text.zh: 针孔、公母、键位与腔位视图按对插图确认。 密封适用性需包含线径与空孔状态。
text.en: Confirm pin/socket arrangement, gender, keying and cavity views against mating drawings. Sealing suitability must include wire size and unused cavities.

text.zh: 线封按绝缘外径选择，未使用腔位的封堵单列。 接点尺寸与载流能力需对应具体件。
text.en: Select seals by insulation diameter and document unused-cavity plugs separately. Contact size/current capability must identify exact parts.

label.en: Sample and release basis

value.en: Approve the component combination, tooling and first article before releasing repeat assembly and agreed verification.
value.zh: 认可零件组合、工装与首件后，再放行重复装配和约定验证。

question.zh: DT、DTM和DTP能按照片混选吗？
question.en: Can DT, DTM and DTP be selected from appearance alone?

answer.zh: DT、DTM和DTP等系列不得按照片混认。分别识别DT、DTM、DTP等具体系列及接点尺寸。
answer.en: Do not identify DT, DTM and DTP interchangeably from photos. Identify the exact family, such as DT, DTM or DTP, and its contact size.

question.zh: 有密封圈就能确定完整密封性能吗？
question.en: Does a seal alone define the complete sealing performance?

answer.zh: 密封适用性需包含线径与空孔状态。针孔、公母、键位与腔位视图按对插图确认。
answer.en: Sealing suitability must include wire size and unused cavities. Confirm pin/socket arrangement, gender, keying and cavity views against mating drawings.

question.zh: 接点尺寸怎样影响线束选型？
question.en: How does contact size affect harness selection?

answer.zh: 接点尺寸与载流能力需对应具体件。线封按绝缘外径选择，未使用腔位的封堵单列。
answer.en: Contact size/current capability must identify exact parts. Select seals by insulation diameter and document unused-cavity plugs separately.

avoidMisidentification.zh: DT、DTM和DTP等系列不得按照片混认
avoidMisidentification.en: Do not identify DT, DTM and DTP interchangeably from photos

avoidMisidentification.en: Sealing suitability must include wire size and unused cavities

introVariants.en: Custom Aptiv-interface harnesses for vehicle and equipment projects, with defined circuits, materials, routing and inspection.
introVariants.zh: 面向车辆与设备项目的 Aptiv 接口定制线束，明确回路、材料、布线与检验要求。

introVariants.en: Weather-Pack, Metri-Pack and GT are distinct systems; match the complete mating references.
introVariants.zh: Weather-Pack、Metri-Pack 与 GT 是不同系统，需匹配完整对插型号。

text.zh: 按设备端系列、键位和实际绝缘外径配套端子与线封。
text.en: Match contacts and seals to the equipment family, keying and actual insulation diameter.

text.zh: 分别审核供电负载、信号腔位及支路固定位置。
text.en: Review power load, signal cavities and branch fixing points separately.

text.zh: 用原连接器件号和端面照片识别接口，再确定替换范围。
text.en: Identify the interface from original connector part numbers and end-face photographs before defining replacement scope.

text.zh: 发动机控制模块端可按项目需求评审。线封与盲塞按实际孔位、导线外径及材料配套。
text.en: For engine control-module ends, review the project conditions. Match seals and plugs to actual cavities, wire diameters and materials.

text.zh: 底盘传感器端可按项目需求评审。TPA、CPA及机械键位分别形成装配检查点。
text.en: For chassis sensor ends, review the project conditions. Set separate inspection points for TPA, CPA and mechanical keying.

text.zh: 车载照明模块端可按项目需求评审。按目标车辆对插件建立受控腔位连接表。
text.en: For vehicle lighting-module ends, review the project conditions. Create a controlled cavity connection table for the target vehicle mate.

title.en: Check the interface and matching parts

text.zh: 记录具体Aptiv系列和端子、壳体的完整后缀。 Weather-Pack与Metri-Pack等系列分别识别。
text.en: Record the exact Aptiv family and complete contact and housing suffixes. Identify Weather-Pack and Metri-Pack series separately.

text.zh: 线封与盲塞按实际孔位、导线外径及材料配套。 端子二次锁与连接器位置锁功能需区分。
text.en: Match seals and plugs to actual cavities, wire diameters and materials. Distinguish terminal secondary locks from connector position assurance.

text.zh: TPA、CPA及机械键位分别形成装配检查点。 密封件颜色不能单独确定适用线径。
text.en: Set separate inspection points for TPA, CPA and mechanical keying. Seal color alone does not establish wire range.

question.zh: Weather-Pack与Metri-Pack可以混用吗？
question.en: Can Weather-Pack and Metri-Pack be mixed?

answer.zh: Weather-Pack与Metri-Pack等系列分别识别。记录具体Aptiv系列和端子、壳体的完整后缀。
answer.en: Identify Weather-Pack and Metri-Pack series separately. Record the exact Aptiv family and complete contact and housing suffixes.

question.zh: TPA与CPA是不是同一种锁？
question.en: Are TPA and CPA the same locking feature?

answer.zh: 端子二次锁与连接器位置锁功能需区分。线封与盲塞按实际孔位、导线外径及材料配套。
answer.en: Distinguish terminal secondary locks from connector position assurance. Match seals and plugs to actual cavities, wire diameters and materials.

question.zh: 线封颜色能直接确定线径范围吗？
question.en: Does seal colour establish the permitted wire size?

answer.zh: 密封件颜色不能单独确定适用线径。TPA、CPA及机械键位分别形成装配检查点。
answer.en: Seal color alone does not establish wire range. Set separate inspection points for TPA, CPA and mechanical keying.

introVariants.zh: 按项目定义 Amphenol 接口电缆与线束，明确连接器选型、材料、布线及检验。

introVariants.en: Choose the exact family, mating references and cable construction; a brand name does not define the assembly.
introVariants.zh: 明确系列、对插料号及电缆结构，品牌名不能定义完整组件。

text.zh: 从具体系列和插芯开始，确定外壳、锁止和操作空间。
text.en: Start with the exact family and insert, then define housing, locking and access.

text.zh: 将屏蔽层到尾壳、外壳和设备地的路径纳入设计。
text.en: Define the shield path through the backshell, housing and equipment ground.

text.zh: 专用接口按项目文件选料，试验依据对应实际插合组合。
text.en: Select specialized interfaces against project documents and test the actual mating combination.

text.zh: 控制柜面板接口可按项目需求评审。独立核对接点排列、键位、针号视图与插入方向。
text.en: For control-cabinet panel interfaces, review the project conditions. Check contact layout, keying, numbering view and insertion direction independently.

text.zh: 设备通信模块端可按项目需求评审。入口夹持范围与屏蔽接续方式按线缆结构匹配。
text.en: For equipment communication-module ends, review the project conditions. Match entry clamping range and shield termination to the cable construction.

text.zh: 测试台架连接端可按项目需求评审。材料、密封件与性能依据按实际组件配置审核。
text.en: For test-bench connection ends, review the project conditions. Review materials, seals and performance documents for the actual assembly configuration.

title.en: Check the interface and matching parts

text.zh: 指定品牌内的具体系列、插芯、外壳和完整料号。 品牌名称覆盖多种系统不能直接互换。
text.en: Specify the exact family, insert, housing and complete part numbers. One brand covers multiple systems that are not automatically interchangeable.

text.zh: 独立核对接点排列、键位、针号视图与插入方向。 工业与专用规范系列需分别审核。
text.en: Check contact layout, keying, numbering view and insertion direction independently. Review industrial and specification-controlled series separately.

text.zh: 入口夹持范围与屏蔽接续方式按线缆结构匹配。 组件性能依据必须对应实际插合组合。
text.en: Match entry clamping range and shield termination to the cable construction. Assembly performance evidence must match the actual mating pair.

value.zh: 审核零件与工装，确认首件后放行重复生产。

question.zh: Amphenol名称能代表一个通用接口吗？
question.en: Does the Amphenol name identify a universal interface?

answer.zh: 品牌名称覆盖多种系统不能直接互换。指定品牌内的具体系列、插芯、外壳和完整料号。
answer.en: One brand covers multiple systems that are not automatically interchangeable. Specify the exact family, insert, housing and complete part numbers.

question.zh: 工业系列与专用系列如何区分？
question.en: How are industrial and specialized families distinguished?

answer.zh: 工业与专用规范系列需分别审核。独立核对接点排列、键位、针号视图与插入方向。
answer.en: Review industrial and specification-controlled series separately. Check contact layout, keying, numbering view and insertion direction independently.

question.zh: 防护或电气性能依据需要对应什么？
question.en: What must protection or electrical performance evidence identify?

answer.zh: 组件性能依据必须对应实际插合组合。入口夹持范围与屏蔽接续方式按线缆结构匹配。
answer.en: Assembly performance evidence must match the actual mating pair. Match entry clamping range and shield termination to the cable construction.

introVariants.en: Custom Hirose-interface harnesses for board wiring, miniature coax and equipment connections, with documented routing, materials and inspection.
introVariants.zh: 定制 Hirose 接口线束，覆盖板内布线、微型同轴及设备连接，明确路径、材料与检验。

introVariants.en: Identify the complete series, mating pair and cable construction before selection.
introVariants.zh: 选型前确认完整系列、对插件及线缆结构。

text.zh: 先审核插合高度、板端方向和壳内维修空间。
text.en: Review mating height, header direction and enclosure service space first.

text.zh: 细线端接应控制剥皮长度、股线保持与热影响。
text.en: Control strip length, strand retention and heat exposure during fine-wire termination.

text.zh: 屏蔽壳与后部抗拉结构按完整安装方式共同确定。
text.en: Define the shield shell and rear strain support together for the installed assembly.

text.zh: 成像模块连接位置可按项目需求评审。把节距、插合高度与板端空间列入尺寸审查。
text.en: For imaging-module connection positions, review the project conditions. Include pitch, mating height and header clearance in dimensional review.

text.zh: 显示控制板端可按项目需求评审。微型端子按真实导体、绝缘外径及端接方式加工。
text.en: For display control-board ends, review the project conditions. Process miniature contacts for the actual conductor, insulation diameter and termination method.

text.zh: 便携设备模块端可按项目需求评审。锁扣、屏蔽壳和线缆支撑按总装状态验证。
text.en: For portable-equipment module ends, review the project conditions. Check the latch, shield shell and cable support in the assembled state.

title.en: Check the interface and matching parts

text.zh: 确认Hirose具体系列、完整料号及板端或线端形式。 不能以HRS标志推定原厂来源。
text.en: Confirm the exact Hirose family, full part number and board or cable form. An HRS mark does not establish original sourcing.

text.zh: 把节距、插合高度与板端空间列入尺寸审查。 板端与线端版本需核对。
text.en: Include pitch, mating height and header clearance in dimensional review. Check board and cable-side variants.

text.zh: 微型端子按真实导体、绝缘外径及端接方式加工。 细线压接或焊接的验收方法需明确。
text.en: Process miniature contacts for the actual conductor, insulation diameter and termination method. Define acceptance for fine-wire crimp or solder joints.

question.zh: HRS标志能证明原厂来源吗？
question.en: Does an HRS marking establish original-component provenance?

answer.zh: 不能以HRS标志推定原厂来源。确认Hirose具体系列、完整料号及板端或线端形式。
answer.en: An HRS mark does not establish original sourcing. Confirm the exact Hirose family, full part number and board or cable form.

question.zh: 同系列板端和线端可以只看针数吗？
question.en: Is position count enough to select board and cable versions?

answer.zh: 板端与线端版本需核对。把节距、插合高度与板端空间列入尺寸审查。
answer.en: Check board and cable-side variants. Include pitch, mating height and header clearance in dimensional review.

question.zh: 细线端接怎样确定检验方法？
question.en: How are inspection methods defined for fine-wire terminations?

answer.zh: 细线压接或焊接的验收方法需明确。微型端子按真实导体、绝缘外径及端接方式加工。
answer.en: Define acceptance for fine-wire crimp or solder joints. Process miniature contacts for the actual conductor, insulation diameter and termination method.

introVariants.zh: 定制 JAE 接口布线，覆盖车载控制、显示及设备模块，明确针脚、材料和检验。

introVariants.en: Match the complete connector series, mating pair and application requirements.
introVariants.zh: 匹配完整接头系列、对插件及应用要求。

text.zh: 按模块接口的针排、极化及锁止形式安排线束。
text.en: Arrange the harness around the contact rows, polarization and locking of the module.

text.zh: 核对绝缘外径和端子支撑，避免把线缆拉力施加到接点。
text.en: Check insulation diameter and terminal support so cable tension is not carried by the contacts.

text.zh: 两端分别匹配，替代方案需用尺寸与插合样件确认。
text.en: Match each end separately and verify alternatives with dimensions and mating samples.

text.zh: 显示模块连接端可按项目需求评审。按受控端视图定义针排、极化及对插端。
text.en: For display-module connection ends, review the project conditions. Define contact rows, polarization and mates from controlled end views.

text.zh: 设备供电模块端可按项目需求评审。端接方式与导体、绝缘外径和工装相匹配。
text.en: For equipment power-module ends, review the project conditions. Match termination method and tooling to conductor and insulation dimensions.

text.zh: 控制器I/O端可按项目需求评审。检查锁止、保持力及安装包络的不同边界。
text.en: For controller i/o ends, review the project conditions. Check locking, retention and installation envelope as separate requirements.

title.en: Check the interface and matching parts

text.zh: 同时记录JAE系列、壳体及端子件号。 相似针排不确定同系列插合。
text.en: Record the JAE family, housing and contact part numbers together. Similar contact rows do not establish same-series mating.

text.zh: 按受控端视图定义针排、极化及对插端。 端子保持与线束拉力分别核对。
text.en: Define contact rows, polarization and mates from controlled end views. Check contact retention separately from harness pull strength.

text.zh: 端接方式与导体、绝缘外径和工装相匹配。 替代件需具体尺寸和插合验证。
text.en: Match termination method and tooling to conductor and insulation dimensions. Alternatives require dimensional and mating verification.

label.en: Exact JAE series, housing and terminal part numbers

question.zh: 相似针排能确定同系列吗？
question.en: Do similar contact rows establish the same family?

answer.zh: 相似针排不确定同系列插合。同时记录JAE系列、壳体及端子件号。
answer.en: Similar contact rows do not establish same-series mating. Record the JAE family, housing and contact part numbers together.

question.zh: 端子保持力和线束拉力是同一检查吗？
question.en: Are contact retention and harness pull force the same check?

answer.zh: 端子保持与线束拉力分别核对。按受控端视图定义针排、极化及对插端。
answer.en: Check contact retention separately from harness pull strength. Define contact rows, polarization and mates from controlled end views.

question.zh: 替代接口需要怎样的验证？
question.en: How is an alternative interface verified?

answer.zh: 替代件需具体尺寸和插合验证。端接方式与导体、绝缘外径和工装相匹配。
answer.en: Alternatives require dimensional and mating verification. Match termination method and tooling to conductor and insulation dimensions.

introVariants.en: Identify the exact family and termination before selecting cable and protection.
introVariants.zh: 先识别具体系列及端接方式，再选择线材与防护。

text.zh: 明确接口形式与针号视图，供电与信号不能只按针数判断。
text.en: Define interface form and numbering view; position count alone does not distinguish power and signals.

text.zh: 先确认板端系列、节距和锁扣，再配置线材和端子。
text.en: Confirm header family, pitch and latch before choosing wire and contacts.

text.zh: 保留两端料号对应关系，防止采购替换改变接口定义。
text.en: Retain part-number mappings at both ends so purchasing changes do not alter the interface definition.

text.zh: 机柜数据接口可按项目需求评审。分别定义线对线、线对板或I/O安装形式。
text.en: For cabinet data interfaces, review the project conditions. Define wire-to-wire, wire-to-board or I/O mounting form separately.

text.zh: 多模块连接位置可按项目需求评审。针位排列、间距和锁止按接口图纸确定。
text.en: For multi-module connection positions, review the project conditions. Define contact arrangement, pitch and locking from interface drawings.

text.zh: 设备检修端口可按项目需求评审。端子镀层、导线与加工规范纳入同一BOM。
text.en: For equipment service ports, review the project conditions. Include contact plating, wire and processing requirements in the same BOM.

question.zh: FCI缩写能代替系列料号吗？
question.en: Can the FCI abbreviation replace a family part number?

answer.en: A brand abbreviation cannot replace series identification. Provide the exact FCI family, complete part numbers and mating-part details.

question.zh: 相同针数的I/O接口能直接接线吗？
question.en: Can I/O interfaces with equal position counts be wired directly?

answer.zh: 相同针数的I/O接口需核对电路与壳体。分别定义线对线、线对板或I/O安装形式。
answer.en: Check circuitry and housing for equal-pin-count I/O interfaces. Define wire-to-wire, wire-to-board or I/O mounting form separately.

question.zh: 供应来源变化怎样保持定义一致？
question.en: How is the definition retained when the component source changes?

answer.zh: 供应来源变更需保留料号对应关系。针位排列、间距和锁止按接口图纸确定。
answer.en: Preserve part-number mapping when sources change. Define contact arrangement, pitch and locking from interface drawings.

introVariants.en: Custom push-pull cable assemblies for instruments, equipment and removable modules, with defined mating parts, pinouts and strain relief.
introVariants.zh: 面向仪器、设备及可拆卸模块的定制推拉式电缆组件，明确对插件、针脚与应力释放。

introVariants.en: Match the connector series, cable construction and handling conditions.
introVariants.zh: 匹配接头系列、线缆结构及操作条件。

text.zh: 围绕推拉锁止、键位和操作方向定义仪器端接口。
text.en: Define the instrument interface around push-pull locking, keying and operating direction.

text.zh: 两端壳号、插芯及针号视图逐一确认，避免镜像接线。
text.en: Confirm shell size, insert and numbering view at each end to prevent mirrored wiring.

text.zh: 线缆外径、尾套长度与夹头支撑共同确定后部结构。
text.en: Define rear construction through cable diameter, boot length and collet support.

text.zh: 可拆探头连接位置可按项目需求评审。用插合面视图记录接点公母和针位映射。
text.en: For detachable probe connections, review the project conditions. Record contact gender and pin mapping from mating-face views.

text.zh: 仪器面板端可按项目需求评审。夹头范围须覆盖实际线缆外径及尾套配置。
text.en: For instrument panel ends, review the project conditions. The collet range must suit the actual cable diameter and boot configuration.

text.zh: 便携测量设备端可按项目需求评审。按焊杯或压接方式确定热影响、绝缘和支撑。
text.en: For portable measurement-equipment ends, review the project conditions. Define heat exposure, insulation and support for solder-cup or crimp termination.

title.en: Check the interface and matching parts

text.zh: 壳号、推拉系列、键位与插芯必须成套确定。 LEMO兼容不等于授权或全系列互换。
text.en: Define shell size, push-pull family, keying and insert as one mating set. LEMO compatibility does not mean authorization or interchangeability across all series.

text.zh: 用插合面视图记录接点公母和针位映射。 外壳号和插芯布局必须同时匹配。
text.en: Record contact gender and pin mapping from mating-face views. Match shell size and insert layout together.

text.zh: 夹头范围须覆盖实际线缆外径及尾套配置。 焊接热影响与细线应力需检查。
text.en: The collet range must suit the actual cable diameter and boot configuration. Check soldering heat effects and fine-wire strain.

label.en: Solder-cup/crimp termination and insulation spacing

value.en: Define heat exposure, insulation and support for solder-cup or crimp termination.

question.zh: LEMO兼容表示品牌授权吗？
question.en: Does LEMO-compatible mean brand authorization?

answer.zh: LEMO兼容不等于授权或全系列互换。壳号、推拉系列、键位与插芯必须成套确定。
answer.en: LEMO compatibility does not mean authorization or interchangeability across all series. Define shell size, push-pull family, keying and insert as one mating set.

question.zh: 只确认外壳号是否足够？
question.en: Is confirming the shell size alone sufficient?

answer.zh: 外壳号和插芯布局必须同时匹配。用插合面视图记录接点公母和针位映射。
answer.en: Match shell size and insert layout together. Record contact gender and pin mapping from mating-face views.

question.zh: 细线焊接端怎样控制应力？
question.en: How is strain controlled at fine-wire solder terminations?

answer.zh: 焊接热影响与细线应力需检查。夹头范围须覆盖实际线缆外径及尾套配置。
answer.en: Check soldering heat effects and fine-wire strain. The collet range must suit the actual cable diameter and boot configuration.

introVariants.en: Custom Binder-interface sensor, data and equipment cables, with specified coding, pinouts, materials and installation support.
introVariants.zh: 定制 Binder 接口传感、数据及设备电缆，明确编码、针脚、材料与安装支撑。

introVariants.en: Select the exact family, coding and protection condition before defining the cable.
introVariants.zh: 定义电缆前，先选择准确系列、编码及防护条件。

text.zh: 按编码、锁紧和设备端布局确定具体接口。
text.en: Define the interface by coding, locking and equipment-side arrangement.

text.zh: 确定可装配或模制形式，再安排线缆入口和维修空间。
text.en: Choose field-assembled or molded construction before defining cable entry and service space.

text.zh: 将夹持、屏蔽和密封状态分别形成装配要求。
text.en: Set separate assembly requirements for clamping, shielding and sealing state.

text.zh: 现场模块连接端可按项目需求评审。锁紧形式、接点排布及极性按对插端确认。
text.en: For field-module connection ends, review the project conditions. Confirm locking, contact layout and polarity against the mating part.

text.zh: 控制面板接口可按项目需求评审。明确装配式或模制式，并匹配入口夹持外径。
text.en: For control-panel interfaces, review the project conditions. Define field-assembled or molded form and match the entry clamping diameter.

text.zh: 可拆卸设备模块端可按项目需求评审。规定插合、锁紧和安装状态下的试验条件。
text.en: For detachable equipment-module ends, review the project conditions. Specify test conditions for the mated, locked and installed state.

text.zh: Binder系列、编码和完整料号同时纳入询价。 相同螺纹尺寸不证明编码相同。
text.en: Include the Binder family, coding and complete part number in the enquiry. Equal thread size does not establish equal coding.

text.zh: 锁紧形式、接点排布及极性按对插端确认。 额定防护需核对插合与锁紧状态。
text.en: Confirm locking, contact layout and polarity against the mating part. Ingress ratings require specified mating and locking conditions.

text.zh: 明确装配式或模制式，并匹配入口夹持外径。 线缆夹持范围需包含实际外径。
text.en: Define field-assembled or molded form and match the entry clamping diameter. The cable clamp range must include the actual diameter.

question.zh: 螺纹尺寸相同就能对插吗？
question.en: Does the same thread size ensure mating?

answer.zh: 相同螺纹尺寸不证明编码相同。Binder系列、编码和完整料号同时纳入询价。
answer.en: Equal thread size does not establish equal coding. Include the Binder family, coding and complete part number in the enquiry.

question.zh: 防护条件为什么要注明锁紧状态？
question.en: Why must protection requirements identify the locked state?

answer.zh: 额定防护需核对插合与锁紧状态。锁紧形式、接点排布及极性按对插端确认。
answer.en: Ingress ratings require specified mating and locking conditions. Confirm locking, contact layout and polarity against the mating part.

question.zh: 线缆入口怎样选夹持范围？
question.en: How is the cable-entry clamping range selected?

answer.zh: 线缆夹持范围需包含实际外径。明确装配式或模制式，并匹配入口夹持外径。
answer.en: The cable clamp range must include the actual diameter. Define field-assembled or molded form and match the entry clamping diameter.

introVariants.en: Identify the exact terminal, circular or heavy-duty interface before defining conductor preparation, protection and test requirements.
introVariants.zh: 先识别准确的端子、圆形或重载接口，再定义导体处理、防护与检验要求。

text.zh: 按夹持方式、导体范围和端头要求配置柜内配线。
text.en: Configure cabinet wiring around clamping method, conductor range and ferrule requirements.

text.zh: 连接器间距之外，还需确认编码、插入方向和配套插座。
text.en: Confirm coding, insertion direction and matching headers as well as connector pitch.

text.zh: 留出剥皮、扭矩工具和维修操作空间，并区分回路功能。
text.en: Allow stripping, torque-tool and service access while identifying circuit functions.

text.zh: PLC端子接线端可按项目需求评审。螺钉或弹簧夹持按导体结构选择端头与加工。
text.en: For plc terminal wiring ends, review the project conditions. Select ferrules and processing for conductor construction and screw or spring clamping.

text.zh: 控制柜门连接端可按项目需求评审。明确插拔方向及编码，避免相同间距跨系列混配。
text.en: For control-cabinet door connections, review the project conditions. Define plug direction and coding to prevent mixing equal-pitch families.

text.zh: 模块检修插接端可按项目需求评审。图纸记录剥皮尺寸、冷压端头和规定扭矩。
text.en: For module service connections, review the project conditions. Record strip length, ferrules and specified torque on the drawing.

text.zh: 完整系列、间距、极数与配套插座共同确定接口。 相同间距不保证跨系列插接。
text.en: Define the interface through the family, pitch, pole count and matching header. Equal pitch does not guarantee cross-series mating.

text.zh: 螺钉或弹簧夹持按导体结构选择端头与加工。 柔性导体和端头适配需核对。
text.en: Select ferrules and processing for conductor construction and screw or spring clamping. Verify flexible-conductor and ferrule suitability.

text.zh: 明确插拔方向及编码，避免相同间距跨系列混配。 端子块额定不能代替完整回路评估。
text.en: Define plug direction and coding to prevent mixing equal-pitch families. Terminal-block ratings do not replace complete-circuit evaluation.

question.zh: 相同间距的Phoenix接口可以混用吗？
question.en: Can equal-pitch Phoenix interfaces be mixed?

answer.zh: 相同间距不保证跨系列插接。完整系列、间距、极数与配套插座共同确定接口。
answer.en: Equal pitch does not guarantee cross-series mating. Define the interface through the family, pitch, pole count and matching header.

question.zh: 柔性导体一定要装同一种端头吗？
question.en: Do all flexible conductors use the same ferrule?

answer.zh: 柔性导体和端头适配需核对。螺钉或弹簧夹持按导体结构选择端头与加工。
answer.en: Verify flexible-conductor and ferrule suitability. Select ferrules and processing for conductor construction and screw or spring clamping.

question.en: Can a terminal-block rating define the complete circuit rating?

answer.en: Terminal-block ratings do not replace complete-circuit evaluation. Define plug direction and coding to prevent mixing equal-pitch families.

introVariants.zh: 采用指定 Panduit 端子、扎带、标识及布线部件制作定制线束，并按准确料号、材料与安装方法审核。

introVariants.en: A component family name does not define a complete harness; control the circuit, conductor, route, installation and acceptance method together.
introVariants.zh: 部件系列名称不能定义完整线束，仍需共同控制回路、导体、路径、安装与验收方法。

text.zh: 导体范围、安装孔径和工具定义端接结构。
text.en: Conductor range, mounting-hole size and tooling define the termination.

text.zh: 将扎带、套管和标识作为独立物料管理，保留维修间距。
text.en: Manage ties, sleeves and labels as separate BOM items while allowing service clearance.

text.zh: 安装面、螺栓和压接方式须与实际导体成套确认。
text.en: Confirm mounting surfaces, fasteners and crimp method for the actual conductor.

text.zh: 汇流排安装端可按项目需求评审。按导体截面、股线结构和安装螺栓选择孔径。
text.en: For busbar mounting ends, review the project conditions. Select barrel range and stud-hole size for conductor area, stranding and mounting hardware.

text.zh: 设备接地安装点可按项目需求评审。用工具与模具料号定义压接过程及检查方法。
text.en: For equipment grounding points, review the project conditions. Define the crimp process and inspection using tool and die part numbers.

text.zh: 机柜线束整理区可按项目需求评审。材料、绝缘和认证范围按具体物料文件核对。
text.en: For cabinet harness-management zones, review the project conditions. Check material, insulation and certification scope against the exact component documents.

title.en: Check the interface and matching parts

text.zh: 区分端子、线鼻子与布线管理件的具体用途。 端接件与扎带等管理配件分别建BOM。
text.en: Distinguish terminals, lugs and cable-management parts by their actual function. List terminations separately from cable-management accessories.

text.zh: 按导体截面、股线结构和安装螺栓选择孔径。 压接颜色标识不能替代模具料号。
text.en: Select barrel range and stud-hole size for conductor area, stranding and mounting hardware. Crimp color codes do not replace die part numbers.

text.zh: 用工具与模具料号定义压接过程及检查方法。 UL或其他标志需具体证书范围。
text.en: Define the crimp process and inspection using tool and die part numbers. UL or other marks require the specific certificate scope.

label.en: Panduit part type, full part number and use

value.zh: 区分端子、线鼻子与布线管理件的具体用途。
value.en: Distinguish terminals, lugs and cable-management parts by their actual function.

value.en: Define the crimp process and inspection using tool and die part numbers.

label.en: Insulation, tie or protection-part material specification

value.zh: 材料、绝缘和认证范围按具体物料文件核对。
value.en: Check material, insulation and certification scope against the exact component documents.

label.zh: 安装与使用边界
label.en: Installation and operating boundary

value.en: Provide original part numbers, wire range, bundle diameter, environment, drawings and the approved substitution boundary.
value.zh: 提供原始料号、适用线径、束径、环境、图纸及认可替代边界。

label.zh: 样品与放行依据
label.en: Sample and release basis

value.en: Approve the component schedule, harness-board baseline, workmanship sample and inspection record before repeat production.
value.zh: 重复生产前确认部件清单、线束板基准、工艺样品及检验记录。

question.zh: 端子和扎带可以用同一组BOM字段吗？
question.en: Can terminals and cable ties use the same BOM definition?

answer.zh: 端接件与扎带等管理配件分别建BOM。区分端子、线鼻子与布线管理件的具体用途。
answer.en: List terminations separately from cable-management accessories. Distinguish terminals, lugs and cable-management parts by their actual function.

question.zh: 颜色标识可以代替压接模具料号吗？
question.en: Can colour coding replace a crimp-die part number?

answer.zh: 压接颜色标识不能替代模具料号。按导体截面、股线结构和安装螺栓选择孔径。
answer.en: Crimp color codes do not replace die part numbers. Select barrel range and stud-hole size for conductor area, stranding and mounting hardware.

question.zh: 标志能证明整条线束取得认证吗？
question.en: Does a component marking establish certification of the whole harness?

answer.zh: UL或其他标志需具体证书范围。用工具与模具料号定义压接过程及检查方法。
answer.en: UL or other marks require the specific certificate scope. Define the crimp process and inspection using tool and die part numbers.

avoidMisidentification.en: UL or other marks require the specific certificate scope

introVariants.en: Custom fuse-holder, battery-feed and power-distribution harnesses built around specified Littelfuse or Eaton Bussmann components.
introVariants.zh: 围绕指定 Littelfuse 或 Eaton Bussmann 元件制作熔断器座、电池馈电与配电线束。

introVariants.en: Fuse, holder, conductor, busbar, enclosure and fault conditions form one protection system.
introVariants.zh: 熔断器、底座、导体、母排、外壳与故障条件共同构成保护系统。

text.zh: 从负载与故障条件出发确定熔断件、保险座和导体。
text.en: Define the fuse, holder and conductors from the load and fault conditions.

text.zh: 将支路长度、环境温度、安装防护和维修位置一起审核。
text.en: Review branch length, ambient temperature, installed protection and service position together.

text.zh: 记录每支路保护器件和回路对应关系，便于检测与维护。
text.en: Record the protective device and circuit association for each branch for inspection and service.

text.zh: 电池支路保护位置可按项目需求评审。保险座和端子按实际线径与安装状态选型。
text.en: For battery-branch protection positions, review the project conditions. Select the holder and contacts for actual wire size and mounting conditions.

text.zh: 继电器模块供电端可按项目需求评审。用系统故障条件审核开断能力及时间电流特性。
text.en: For relay-module power ends, review the project conditions. Review interrupting capacity and time-current behavior against system fault conditions.

text.zh: 可维护保险座位置可按项目需求评审。负载、环境温度、导体与支路防护共同确定。
text.en: For serviceable fuse-holder positions, review the project conditions. Define load, ambient temperature, conductors and branch protection together.

title.en: Check the interface and matching parts

text.zh: 指定熔断件品牌、完整类型、料号和所需额定。 Littelfuse与Bussmann不得当成同一料号来源。
text.en: Specify fuse brand, full type, part number and required ratings. Do not treat Littelfuse and Bussmann as one part-number source.

text.zh: 保险座和端子按实际线径与安装状态选型。 保险座能力与熔断件额定分别核对。
text.en: Select the holder and contacts for actual wire size and mounting conditions. Check holder capability separately from fuse ratings.

text.zh: 用系统故障条件审核开断能力及时间电流特性。 保护协调必须包含负载和导体。
text.en: Review interrupting capacity and time-current behavior against system fault conditions. Protection coordination must include the load and conductor.

label.zh: 保险丝品牌、类型、额定与料号
label.en: Fuse brand, type, rating and part number

value.zh: 指定熔断件品牌、完整类型、料号和所需额定。
value.en: Specify fuse brand, full type, part number and required ratings.

label.zh: 保险座、端子与线径匹配
label.en: Fuse holder, terminals and wire-size matching

value.zh: 保险座和端子按实际线径与安装状态选型。
value.en: Select the holder and contacts for actual wire size and mounting conditions.

label.zh: 故障电流、开断和时间电流依据
label.en: Fault current, interrupting and time-current evidence

value.zh: 用系统故障条件审核开断能力及时间电流特性。
value.en: Review interrupting capacity and time-current behavior against system fault conditions.

label.zh: 支路负载、环境温度与密封
label.en: Branch load, ambient temperature and sealing

value.zh: 负载、环境温度、导体与支路防护共同确定。
value.en: Define load, ambient temperature, conductors and branch protection together.

label.zh: 安装与使用边界
label.en: Installation and operating boundary

value.en: Provide exact part numbers, circuit duty, fault current, cable sizes, environment and validation requirements.
value.zh: 提供准确料号、回路工况、故障电流、线缆规格、环境与验证要求。

label.zh: 样品与放行依据
label.en: Sample and release basis

value.en: Approve the schematic, BOM, sample, torque and electrical inspection records before repeat production.
value.zh: 重复生产前确认原理图、BOM、样品、扭矩及电气检验记录。

question.zh: Littelfuse和Bussmann可以视为同一来源吗？
question.en: Can Littelfuse and Bussmann be treated as the same source?

answer.zh: Littelfuse与Bussmann不得当成同一料号来源。指定熔断件品牌、完整类型、料号和所需额定。
answer.en: Do not treat Littelfuse and Bussmann as one part-number source. Specify fuse brand, full type, part number and required ratings.

question.zh: 保险座和熔断件额定是否需要分别核对？
question.en: Must fuse-holder and fuse ratings be checked separately?

answer.zh: 保险座能力与熔断件额定分别核对。保险座和端子按实际线径与安装状态选型。
answer.en: Check holder capability separately from fuse ratings. Select the holder and contacts for actual wire size and mounting conditions.

question.zh: 熔断件选型只需要额定电流吗？
question.en: Is rated current alone enough to select a fuse?

answer.zh: 保护协调必须包含负载和导体。用系统故障条件审核开断能力及时间电流特性。
answer.en: Protection coordination must include the load and conductor. Review interrupting capacity and time-current behavior against system fault conditions.

avoidMisidentification.en: Do not treat Littelfuse and Bussmann as one part-number source

introVariants.en: Custom Anderson interface cable projects for Powerpole, SB and specified battery-power connectors. We define the exact housing, contact, keying, polarity, conductor, termination and installation duty before making a cable, jumper, charger lead or equipment pigtail.
introVariants.zh: 按指定 Anderson 接口制作 Powerpole、SB 等电源连接电缆项目。无论是电池引线、充电线、设备尾线还是转接组件，先确定壳体、触点、防误插、极性、导体、端接与实际工况，再定义线缆。

introVariants.en: Powerpole modular housings and two-pole SB housings are different connection systems. A family name alone does not establish mating fit, current rating or polarity. Contact part number, cable cross-section, temperature rise, assembly method and the manufacturer's series-specific documentation all matter.
introVariants.zh: 模块化 Powerpole 与双极 SB 属于不同连接体系。仅凭系列名称不能认定可对插、电流额定值或极性。触点料号、线径、温升、装配方法及制造商对应系列资料都必须纳入审核。

text.zh: 按系列键位、极性与设备安装空间定义电源接口。
text.en: Define the power interface around family keying, polarity and equipment clearance.

text.zh: 接点导体范围、线长和端接支撑按实际回路配置。
text.en: Configure contact conductor range, cable length and termination support for the circuit.

text.zh: 说明插拔状态、持续负载和温升条件，再安排固定与保护。
text.en: Define mating state, continuous load and temperature-rise conditions before fixing and protection.

text.zh: 可拆卸电池接口可按项目需求评审。颜色须结合机械键位和极性一并确认。
text.en: For detachable battery interfaces, review the project conditions. Confirm colour together with mechanical keying and polarity.

text.zh: 设备电源转接端可按项目需求评审。接点导体范围、镀层和工具按料号文件匹配。
text.en: For equipment power-adapter ends, review the project conditions. Match conductor range, plating and tooling to the contact part documents.

text.zh: 维护隔离连接位置可按项目需求评审。分别规定持续电流、温升条件与允许插拔工况。
text.en: For service-disconnection positions, review the project conditions. Specify continuous current, temperature-rise conditions and permitted mating duty separately.

title.en: Check the interface and matching parts

text.zh: 按具体Anderson系列确定壳体及配套接点。 颜色需结合具体系列的机械键位核对。
text.en: Define housings and matching contacts for the exact Anderson family. Check color against mechanical keying for the exact series.

text.zh: 颜色须结合机械键位和极性一并确认。 同壳体可配不同线径接点。
text.en: Confirm colour together with mechanical keying and polarity. One housing may use contacts for different wire sizes.

text.zh: 接点导体范围、镀层和工具按料号文件匹配。 不带载与带载插拔要求分别确认。
text.en: Match conductor range, plating and tooling to the contact part documents. Confirm no-load and load-break mating requirements separately.

label.zh: Anderson具体系列、壳体与接点
label.en: Exact Anderson series, housing and contacts

value.zh: 按具体Anderson系列确定壳体及配套接点。
value.en: Define housings and matching contacts for the exact Anderson family.

label.zh: 颜色键位、极性与插合组合
label.en: Color keying, polarity and mating pair

value.zh: 颜色须结合机械键位和极性一并确认。
value.en: Confirm colour together with mechanical keying and polarity.

label.zh: 接点导体范围、镀层与工具
label.en: Contact conductor range, plating and tools

value.zh: 接点导体范围、镀层和工具按料号文件匹配。
value.en: Match conductor range, plating and tooling to the contact part documents.

label.zh: 持续电流、插拔条件与温升
label.en: Continuous current, mating duty and temperature rise

value.zh: 分别规定持续电流、温升条件与允许插拔工况。
value.en: Specify continuous current, temperature-rise conditions and permitted mating duty separately.

label.zh: 安装与使用边界
label.en: Installation and operating boundary

value.en: Supply the manufacturer and complete connector series or part number, mating-side photograph and contact view, circuit and polarity drawing, continuous and peak load, voltage, wire size and cable length, opposite-end interface, installation environment, quantity and acceptance criteria. Identify auxiliary contacts or battery-monitoring circuits separately.
value.zh: 请提供制造商及完整接口系列／料号、对插侧照片与触点视图、回路和极性图、连续与峰值负载、电压、线径与长度、另一端接口、安装环境、数量和接收标准。辅助触点或电池监测回路须单独标明。

label.zh: 样品与放行依据
label.en: Sample and release basis

value.en: The approved inputs become a controlled connector-and-contact BOM, cable drawing, polarity map, assembly instructions and first-article checklist. The inspection scope can cover wire identity, crimp geometry, contact retention, housing keying, cable length and agreed electrical checks. Continuity alone cannot prove rated-load temperature, charging-system compatibility or equipment safety.
value.zh: 批准资料将转成受控的壳体与触点物料表、线缆图、极性表、装配指引和首件核对清单。检验范围可包括线号、压接几何、触点保持、壳体防错、长度及约定电气项目。导通合格不能单独证明额定负载温升、充电系统兼容或设备安全。

question.zh: 颜色相同就一定能够插合吗？
question.en: Does matching colour always ensure mating?

answer.zh: 颜色需结合具体系列的机械键位核对。按具体Anderson系列确定壳体及配套接点。
answer.en: Check color against mechanical keying for the exact series. Define housings and matching contacts for the exact Anderson family.

question.zh: 同一壳体可否装不同线径接点？
question.en: Can one housing accept contacts for different wire sizes?

answer.zh: 同壳体可配不同线径接点。颜色须结合机械键位和极性一并确认。
answer.en: One housing may use contacts for different wire sizes. Confirm colour together with mechanical keying and polarity.

question.zh: 带载和不带载插拔需要区分吗？
question.en: Must loaded and unloaded mating conditions be distinguished?

answer.zh: 不带载与带载插拔要求分别确认。接点导体范围、镀层和工具按料号文件匹配。
answer.en: Confirm no-load and load-break mating requirements separately. Match conductor range, plating and tooling to the contact part documents.

avoidMisidentification.en: Check color against mechanical keying for the exact series

avoidMisidentification.en: One housing may use contacts for different wire sizes

avoidMisidentification.en: Confirm no-load and load-break mating requirements separately

introVariants.zh: 围绕指定 HARTING Han 系列接口制作可拆卸机台、控制柜与设备模块连接电缆。以完整料号、对插件、回路图和安装环境定义组件；名称相近的外壳、插芯与触点不能未经核对直接互换。
introVariants.en: Cable assemblies built around a specified HARTING Han interface for removable machines, control cabinets and equipment modules. The complete part references, mating half, circuit drawing and installation duty define the assembly; similarly named hoods, inserts and contacts are not automatically interchangeable.

introVariants.zh: Han 是矩形工业连接器家族，不是一种固定针位的插头。选型可能涉及外壳、底座、单体插芯或 Han-Modular 框架、功率／信号／数据模块、触点、锁扣与进线件。实际电气和环境能力取决于所选整套部件及其装配条件。
introVariants.en: Han is a family of rectangular industrial connectors, not one fixed pinout. A configuration may include hood, housing, monobloc insert or Han-Modular frame, power/signal/data modules, contacts, latches and cable entry. Electrical and environmental performance belongs to the specified complete assembly and its installation conditions.

text.zh: 按框架与模块定义动力、信号和保护接地分区。
text.en: Define power, signal and protective-ground allocation through the frame and modules.

text.zh: 外壳、锁扣、入口方向和面板固定形成完整安装界面。
text.en: Combine housing, latch, cable entry and panel fixing into the installed interface.

text.zh: 支路接口与模块针位各自记录，接地与屏蔽路径单列。
text.en: Record branch interfaces and module positions separately, with distinct grounding and shield paths.

text.zh: 柜体动力进线端可按项目需求评审。外壳尺寸、锁扣和面板固定按总装空间定义。
text.en: For cabinet power-entry positions, review the project conditions. Define housing size, latch and panel fixing around assembly clearance.

text.zh: 模块化设备接口可按项目需求评审。动力、信号和接地接点对应实际线径与模块。
text.en: For modular equipment interfaces, review the project conditions. Assign power, signal and ground contacts to the actual conductors and modules.

text.zh: 设备维护分线端可按项目需求评审。入口、尾壳、壳体接地与电缆屏蔽分别记录。
text.en: For equipment service fan-outs, review the project conditions. Document cable entry, backshell, housing ground and cable shield separately.

title.en: Check the interface and matching parts

text.zh: 确认Harting系列、框架及每个模块的安装顺序。 重载外壳外形不能证明内部模块一致。
text.en: Confirm the Harting family, frame and installation order of every module. Heavy-duty shell shape does not establish matching internal modules.

text.zh: 外壳尺寸、锁扣和面板固定按总装空间定义。 插芯序列与键位需成套确认。
text.en: Define housing size, latch and panel fixing around assembly clearance. Confirm insert sequence and keying as a set.

text.zh: 动力、信号和接地接点对应实际线径与模块。 接地接点和壳体接地需分开记录。
text.en: Assign power, signal and ground contacts to the actual conductors and modules. Record earth contacts and housing grounding separately.

label.zh: Harting系列、框架与模块配置
label.en: Harting series, frame and module configuration

value.zh: 确认Harting系列、框架及每个模块的安装顺序。
value.en: Confirm the Harting family, frame and installation order of every module.

label.zh: 外壳尺寸、锁扣及安装形式
label.en: Housing size, latch and mounting style

value.zh: 外壳尺寸、锁扣和面板固定按总装空间定义。
value.en: Define housing size, latch and panel fixing around assembly clearance.

label.zh: 接点、线径与动力信号分区
label.en: Contacts, wire sizes and power/signal allocation

value.zh: 动力、信号和接地接点对应实际线径与模块。
value.en: Assign power, signal and ground contacts to the actual conductors and modules.

label.zh: 电缆入口、接地和屏蔽尾壳
label.en: Cable entry, grounding and shielding backshell

value.zh: 入口、尾壳、壳体接地与电缆屏蔽分别记录。
value.en: Document cable entry, backshell, housing ground and cable shield separately.

label.zh: 安装与使用边界
label.en: Installation and operating boundary

value.zh: 询价请提供 Han 系列与外壳尺寸、每个外壳／底座／插芯或模块／触点的料号、对插面视图、针脚与回路表、负载与电压、导体和护套、出线方向、格兰头与锁扣形式、安装环境、数量及验收要求。品牌兼容不代表 HARTING 授权或认证。
value.en: For quotation, provide the Han series and housing size; part numbers for each hood, base, insert or module and contact; mating-face view, pin and circuit map, load and voltage, conductors and jacket, cable-exit direction, gland and latch choice, environment, quantity and acceptance criteria. Compatible work does not imply HARTING authorization or certification.

label.zh: 样品与放行依据
label.en: Sample and release basis

value.zh: 经客户确认后形成受控物料表、回路图、端接与装配指引、首件核对点和约定检验项目。重点核对插芯朝向、接点位置、触点入位、锁扣闭合、进线夹持、线长与导通；IP、防振或额定负载表现须按准确产品资料与项目试验单独证明。
value.en: Approved inputs become a controlled BOM, circuit drawing, termination and assembly instructions, first-article checkpoints and agreed inspections. Check insert orientation, contact position and seating, latch closure, cable-entry retention, length and continuity. IP, vibration or rated-load performance requires the exact product data and separately defined project evidence.

question.zh: 外壳相同是否意味着内部模块相同？
question.en: Do equal housings mean the internal modules match?

answer.zh: 重载外壳外形不能证明内部模块一致。确认Harting系列、框架及每个模块的安装顺序。
answer.en: Heavy-duty shell shape does not establish matching internal modules. Confirm the Harting family, frame and installation order of every module.

question.zh: 模块顺序和键位为什么要成套确认？
question.en: Why confirm module order and keying as a set?

answer.zh: 插芯序列与键位需成套确认。外壳尺寸、锁扣和面板固定按总装空间定义。
answer.en: Confirm insert sequence and keying as a set. Define housing size, latch and panel fixing around assembly clearance.

question.zh: 接地接点和壳体接地可以合并记录吗？
question.en: Can ground contacts and housing ground be recorded as one item?

answer.zh: 接地接点和壳体接地需分开记录。动力、信号和接地接点对应实际线径与模块。
answer.en: Record earth contacts and housing grounding separately. Assign power, signal and ground contacts to the actual conductors and modules.

avoidMisidentification.en: Heavy-duty shell shape does not establish matching internal modules

avoidMisidentification.zh: 插芯序列与键位需成套确认
avoidMisidentification.en: Confirm insert sequence and keying as a set

avoidMisidentification.zh: 接地接点和壳体接地需分开记录
avoidMisidentification.en: Record earth contacts and housing grounding separately

introVariants.zh: 围绕客户指定的矢崎 Yazaki 连接器，制作传感器引线、车身分支、设备转接与可拆卸线束。先核对准确壳体、端子、线封、二次锁及对插件，再决定针脚、线材和安装走向；系列名称本身不能代替完整配置。
introVariants.en: Sensor leads, vehicle branches, equipment adapters and removable harnesses built around customer-specified Yazaki connectors. We verify the exact housing, terminal, wire seal, secondary lock and mating half before defining pins, cable and routing; a family name is not a complete configuration.

introVariants.zh: 矢崎汽车连接器目录同时包含防水与非防水、线对线与设备端等不同结构。YESC、YMT 1.2、0.64（025）、1.5（060）、2.3（090）等名称有助于定位系列，但极数、防错编码、端子尺寸与密封方式仍须落实到料号和图纸。
introVariants.en: Yazaki's automotive connector catalog spans sealed and unsealed, wire-to-wire and device-side structures. Names such as YESC, YMT 1.2, 0.64 (025), 1.5 (060) and 2.3 (090) help locate a family, but cavity count, keying, terminal size and sealing must still be resolved by part number and drawing.

text.zh: 识别原设备对插件、键位及腔位视图，再确定线封和端子。
text.en: Identify the equipment mate, keying and cavity view before selecting seals and contacts.

text.zh: 支路接口、固定点和线长基准分别写入图纸。
text.en: Record branch interfaces, fixing points and length datums separately on the drawing.

text.zh: 服务号与连接器件号分开追踪，替换范围对应具体接口。
text.en: Track service numbers and connector part numbers separately, with replacement scope tied to the exact interface.

text.zh: 车身控制模块端可按项目需求评审。按车辆对插件确认键位、针位图和接口方向。
text.en: For body control-module ends, review the project conditions. Confirm keying, cavity drawings and orientation against the vehicle mate.

text.zh: 车载灯具连接端可按项目需求评审。线封、二次锁与实际导体及绝缘外径配套。
text.en: For vehicle lamp connection ends, review the project conditions. Match seals and secondary locks to the actual conductor and insulation diameter.

text.zh: 车辆传感器转接端可按项目需求评审。保持、密封和温度要求按实际配置确定验收依据。
text.en: For vehicle sensor-adapter ends, review the project conditions. Define retention, sealing and temperature acceptance for the actual configuration.

title.en: Check the interface and matching parts

text.zh: 保留Yazaki系列、壳体和端子件号的完整后缀。 车厂服务号与连接器件号分别记录。
text.en: Retain complete Yazaki family, housing and contact part-number suffixes. Record vehicle service numbers separately from connector numbers.

text.zh: 按车辆对插件确认键位、针位图和接口方向。 二次锁装配状态要有检查点。
text.en: Confirm keying, cavity drawings and orientation against the vehicle mate. Include secondary-lock assembly status in inspection.

text.zh: 线封、二次锁与实际导体及绝缘外径配套。 车型照片不能证明全平台兼容。
text.en: Match seals and secondary locks to the actual conductor and insulation diameter. Vehicle photos do not establish whole-platform compatibility.

label.zh: Yazaki系列、壳体与端子完整料号
label.en: Full Yazaki series, housing and terminal part numbers

value.zh: 保留Yazaki系列、壳体和端子件号的完整后缀。
value.en: Retain complete Yazaki family, housing and contact part-number suffixes.

label.zh: 车辆对插件、针位与键位
label.en: Vehicle mating part, pin layout and keying

value.zh: 按车辆对插件确认键位、针位图和接口方向。
value.en: Confirm keying, cavity drawings and orientation against the vehicle mate.

label.zh: 线封、二次锁和适用线径
label.en: Wire seals, secondary locks and wire range

value.zh: 线封、二次锁与实际导体及绝缘外径配套。
value.en: Match seals and secondary locks to the actual conductor and insulation diameter.

label.zh: 端子保持、密封及温度依据
label.en: Contact retention, sealing and temperature evidence

value.zh: 保持、密封和温度要求按实际配置确定验收依据。
value.en: Define retention, sealing and temperature acceptance for the actual configuration.

label.zh: 安装与使用边界
label.en: Installation and operating boundary

value.zh: 询价请提供两侧壳体与对插件料号、正视针脚图、端子和线封、回路表、导体规格、环境与温度、固定点、分支尺寸、数量和验收要求。照片和旧样可辅助识别，却不能证明不可见的电气功能或替代料获准。
value.en: For quotation, provide housing and mating part numbers, mating-face pin views, terminals and seals, circuit map, conductors, environment and temperature, fixing points, branch dimensions, quantity and acceptance criteria. Photos or an old sample aid identification but do not authorize unseen electrical functions or substitute parts.

label.zh: 样品与放行依据
label.en: Sample and release basis

value.zh: 批准后的配置转化为受控 BOM、针脚表、加工与首件检查点。核查压接、端子保持、线封位置、二次锁、支路尺寸、导通与对插；防水、耐振、耐压或整车适配须以指定零件资料和项目试验单独确认。
value.en: Approved inputs become a controlled BOM, pin map, assembly instructions and first-article checkpoints. Check crimps, terminal retention, seal position, secondary lock, branch dimensions, continuity and mating. Ingress, vibration, dielectric or vehicle-level suitability requires exact component data and separately agreed project validation.

question.zh: 车厂服务号等同于连接器件号吗？
question.en: Is a vehicle service number the same as a connector part number?

answer.zh: 车厂服务号与连接器件号分别记录。保留Yazaki系列、壳体和端子件号的完整后缀。
answer.en: Record vehicle service numbers separately from connector numbers. Retain complete Yazaki family, housing and contact part-number suffixes.

question.zh: 二次锁安装如何纳入检查？
question.en: How is secondary-lock assembly included in inspection?

answer.zh: 二次锁装配状态要有检查点。按车辆对插件确认键位、针位图和接口方向。
answer.en: Include secondary-lock assembly status in inspection. Confirm keying, cavity drawings and orientation against the vehicle mate.

question.zh: 同车型照片能证明全平台适配吗？
question.en: Does a vehicle photograph establish platform-wide fitment?

answer.zh: 车型照片不能证明全平台兼容。线封、二次锁与实际导体及绝缘外径配套。
answer.en: Vehicle photos do not establish whole-platform compatibility. Match seals and secondary locks to the actual conductor and insulation diameter.

avoidMisidentification.zh: 车厂服务号与连接器件号分别记录
avoidMisidentification.en: Record vehicle service numbers separately from connector numbers

avoidMisidentification.zh: 二次锁装配状态要有检查点
avoidMisidentification.en: Include secondary-lock assembly status in inspection

avoidMisidentification.en: Vehicle photos do not establish whole-platform compatibility

introVariants.zh: 围绕客户指定的 Conxall 系列接口制作定制电缆组件。核对 Micro-Con-X、Mini-Con-X、Multi-Con-X 或屏蔽型的准确料号、触点排列、对插件与安装状态，再定义线材、端接、分支和检验方案。
introVariants.en: Custom cable assemblies for customer-specified Conxall-family interfaces. We verify exact Micro-Con-X, Mini-Con-X, Multi-Con-X or shielded part numbers, contact arrangements, mating halves and installation conditions before defining cable, termination, branches and inspection.

introVariants.zh: 具体系列、壳号、键位与接点布局共同定义连接系统；线缆入口与密封需按实际安装审核。
introVariants.en: The exact family, shell size, keying and contact layout define the connection system. Review cable entry and sealing for the actual installation.

text.zh: 按壳号、键位、锁紧方式和接点公母定义接口。
text.en: Define the interface through shell size, keying, locking and contact gender.

text.zh: 结合线缆外径、尾套和设备后部空间安排出线。
text.en: Arrange the cable exit around diameter, boot and rear equipment clearance.

text.zh: 把线缆入口和插合边界分别纳入环境与安装审核。
text.en: Review cable entry and mating boundaries separately for environment and installation.

text.zh: 仪器面板连接位置可按项目需求评审。针数之外核对键位、锁紧方式与接点公母。
text.en: For instrument panel connection positions, review the project conditions. Check keying, locking and contact gender as well as position count.

text.zh: 工业设备外部接口可按项目需求评审。入口、尾套及模制结构按实际电缆匹配。
text.en: For external industrial-equipment interfaces, review the project conditions. Match entry, boot and molded construction to the actual cable.

text.zh: 便携设备可拆引线可按项目需求评审。按完整插合和安装状态确定密封材料及试验。
text.en: For detachable portable-equipment leads, review the project conditions. Define sealing materials and tests for the fully mated and installed assembly.

title.en: Check the interface and matching parts

text.zh: 指定Conxall具体系列、壳号和接点组合。 相近圆形接口不得按针数混配。
text.en: Specify the exact Conxall family, shell size and contact combination. Do not mix similar circular interfaces by pin count.

text.zh: 针数之外核对键位、锁紧方式与接点公母。 原始来源型号仅作检索线索。
text.en: Check keying, locking and contact gender as well as position count. Original source models are search clues only.

text.zh: 入口、尾套及模制结构按实际电缆匹配。 防护额定需包含规定插合及安装条件。
text.en: Match entry, boot and molded construction to the actual cable. Ingress ratings must include specified mating and installation conditions.

label.zh: Conxall具体系列、壳号与接点
label.en: Exact Conxall series, shell size and contacts

value.zh: 指定Conxall具体系列、壳号和接点组合。
value.en: Specify the exact Conxall family, shell size and contact combination.

label.zh: 插合键位、锁紧方式与公母
label.en: Keying, locking method and gender

value.zh: 针数之外核对键位、锁紧方式与接点公母。
value.en: Check keying, locking and contact gender as well as position count.

label.zh: 线缆入口、尾套和模制结构
label.en: Cable entry, boot and molded construction

value.zh: 入口、尾套及模制结构按实际电缆匹配。
value.en: Match entry, boot and molded construction to the actual cable.

label.zh: 密封材料及完整插合试验条件
label.en: Seal materials and full-mating test conditions

value.zh: 按完整插合和安装状态确定密封材料及试验。
value.en: Define sealing materials and tests for the fully mated and installed assembly.

label.zh: 安装与使用边界
label.en: Installation and operating boundary

value.zh: 请提供完整系列与料号、对插端面图、线缆外径、安装空间和环境条件。
value.en: Provide the complete family and part numbers, mating-face drawings, cable diameter, installation clearance and environmental conditions.

label.zh: 样品与放行依据
label.en: Sample and release basis

value.zh: 按认可图纸与BOM制作样品，确认插合、端接、尺寸和约定试验后再放行。
value.en: Build samples to approved drawings and BOM, then confirm mating, terminations, dimensions and agreed tests before release.

question.zh: 相近圆形接口可以只按针数混配吗？
question.en: Can similar circular interfaces be mixed by position count alone?

answer.zh: 相近圆形接口不得按针数混配。指定Conxall具体系列、壳号和接点组合。
answer.en: Do not mix similar circular interfaces by pin count. Specify the exact Conxall family, shell size and contact combination.

question.zh: 仅有一个型号能确认完整插合吗？
question.en: Does one model string confirm the complete mating combination?

answer.zh: 原始来源型号仅作检索线索。针数之外核对键位、锁紧方式与接点公母。
answer.en: Original source models are search clues only. Check keying, locking and contact gender as well as position count.

question.zh: 防护要求为什么需要完整安装状态？
question.en: Why do protection requirements need the complete installation state?

answer.zh: 防护额定需包含规定插合及安装条件。入口、尾套及模制结构按实际电缆匹配。
answer.en: Ingress ratings must include specified mating and installation conditions. Match entry, boot and molded construction to the actual cable.

avoidMisidentification.en: Do not mix similar circular interfaces by pin count

avoidMisidentification.en: Original source models are search clues only

introVariants.en: Custom fine-pitch wire-to-board and compact sensor harnesses using project-approved 32AWG or other fine conductors.
introVariants.zh: 采用项目认可的 32AWG 或其他细导体制作细间距板端与紧凑传感线束。

introVariants.en: Fine geometry requires exact control of contact, wire, stripping, crimping, insertion and strain relief.
introVariants.zh: 精细几何需要准确控制触点、线材、剥线、压接、装壳与应力释放。

text.zh: 在有限空间中核对细线端接、连接器间距和支撑位置。
text.en: Check fine-wire termination, connector pitch and support positions within the available space.

text.zh: 控制剥皮和股线损伤，并定义进入壳体后的弯曲路线。
text.en: Control stripping and strand damage, and define the bend route inside the enclosure.

text.zh: 先确认针位视图和导体适配，再安排分支和标识。
text.en: Confirm cavity views and conductor suitability before arranging branches and identification.

text.zh: 微型显示板连接可按项目需求评审。按完整端子系列核对间距、针位与导体适配范围。
text.en: For miniature display-board connections, review the project conditions. Check pitch, cavity positions and conductor range for the full contact family.

text.zh: 小型执行器引线可按项目需求评审。分别确定剥皮、压接或焊接的工艺与检查方法。
text.en: For compact actuator leads, review the project conditions. Define processing and inspection separately for stripping, crimping or soldering.

text.zh: 高密度模块分支可按项目需求评审。设置近端支撑、安装弯曲空间和明确的拉力验收。
text.en: For high-density module branches, review the project conditions. Provide near-end support, installation bend clearance and a defined pull-test method.

text.zh: 实际AWG、股数、导体材质和绝缘外径需由线材文件确认。 32AWG分类名不证明每张示例都是32AWG。
text.en: Confirm actual AWG, strand count, conductor material and insulation diameter from wire documents. The 32AWG category name does not establish every example's gauge.

text.zh: 按完整端子系列核对间距、针位与导体适配范围。 微型端子导体和绝缘压接均需检查。
text.en: Check pitch, cavity positions and conductor range for the full contact family. Inspect both conductor and insulation crimps on miniature contacts.

text.zh: 分别确定剥皮、压接或焊接的工艺与检查方法。 端接拉力方法和限值需明确定义。
text.en: Define processing and inspection separately for stripping, crimping or soldering. Define termination pull-test method and limits.

value.en: Define processing and inspection separately for stripping, crimping or soldering.

value.zh: 提供完整接口料号、线材结构、回路图、布线包络与检验限值。

label.en: Sample and release basis

value.en: Approve the crimp setup, sample, magnified inspection and electrical test records before repeat production.
value.zh: 重复生产前确认压接设置、样品、放大检验与电气测试记录。

question.zh: 每个细间距示例都是32AWG吗？
question.en: Is every fine-pitch example made with 32AWG wire?

answer.zh: 32AWG分类名不证明每张示例都是32AWG。实际AWG、股数、导体材质和绝缘外径需由线材文件确认。
answer.en: The 32AWG category name does not establish every example's gauge. Confirm actual AWG, strand count, conductor material and insulation diameter from wire documents.

question.zh: 微型端子压接要检查哪些部位？
question.en: Which parts of a miniature crimp need inspection?

answer.zh: 微型端子导体和绝缘压接均需检查。按完整端子系列核对间距、针位与导体适配范围。
answer.en: Inspect both conductor and insulation crimps on miniature contacts. Check pitch, cavity positions and conductor range for the full contact family.

question.zh: 细线拉力验收怎样定义？
question.en: How is fine-wire pull acceptance defined?

answer.zh: 端接拉力方法和限值需明确定义。分别确定剥皮、压接或焊接的工艺与检查方法。
answer.en: Define termination pull-test method and limits. Define processing and inspection separately for stripping, crimping or soldering.

introVariants.en: Custom molded cable exits that manage pull, bend and torsion through coordinated geometry, resin compatibility, insert control and validation.
introVariants.zh: 通过协同几何、树脂相容性、嵌件控制与验证，定制管理拉力、弯曲与扭转的注塑出线结构。

introVariants.en: A cable boot is a controlled mechanical transition between a rigid interface and a flexible cable.
introVariants.zh: 线缆护套是刚性接口与柔性线缆之间的受控机械过渡。

text.zh: 尾套应把设备动作带来的弯曲分散到允许的线缆区域。
text.en: The boot should spread equipment-motion bending over the permitted cable region.

text.zh: 连接器、护套和包胶交界共同决定受力路线。
text.en: Connector, jacket and molding transitions together define the load path.

text.zh: 按夹持点、出线角和检修动作安排尾套长度。
text.en: Set boot length around fixing points, exit angle and service movement.

text.zh: 控制柜门出线可按项目需求评审。按护套材料与目标弯曲条件选硬度和粘接方式。
text.en: For control-cabinet door cable exits, review the project conditions. Select hardness and bonding for the jacket material and intended bending duty.

text.zh: 便携设备插头后部可按项目需求评审。嵌件支撑、分型位置和成型条件应保护内部端接。
text.en: For rear plugs on portable equipment, review the project conditions. Insert support, parting lines and molding conditions should protect internal terminations.

text.zh: 机箱穿板出线可按项目需求评审。按完整安装状态验证弯折、拉力与固定保持。
text.en: For enclosure through-panel cable exits, review the project conditions. Verify bending, pull force and fixing retention in the installed configuration.

text.zh: 定义尾套长度、外形、出线角度和附近固定点。 外部模制结构不能单独证明防水。
text.en: Define boot length, profile, exit angle and nearby fixing points. External molded geometry alone does not establish sealing.

text.zh: 按护套材料与目标弯曲条件选硬度和粘接方式。 软硬材料交界处需检查弯折集中。
text.en: Select hardness and bonding for the jacket material and intended bending duty. Check bend concentration at soft/hard material transitions.

text.zh: 嵌件支撑、分型位置和成型条件应保护内部端接。 工艺温度不能损伤内部绝缘或焊点。
text.en: Insert support, parting lines and molding conditions should protect internal terminations. Process temperature must not damage internal insulation or solder joints.

label.en: Strain-relief geometry, length and exit angle

value.zh: 定义尾套长度、外形、出线角度和附近固定点。
value.en: Define boot length, profile, exit angle and nearby fixing points.

value.zh: 嵌件支撑、分型位置和成型条件应保护内部端接。
value.en: Insert support, parting lines and molding conditions should protect internal terminations.

label.en: Bend, pull and retention inspection plan

value.zh: 按完整安装状态验证弯折、拉力与固定保持。
value.en: Verify bending, pull force and fixing retention in the installed configuration.

label.en: Installation and operating boundary

value.en: Provide insert and cable drawings, jacket construction, installed bend envelope, environment and test method.
value.zh: 提供嵌件与线缆图纸、护套结构、安装弯曲包络、环境与试验方法。

label.zh: 样品与放行依据
label.en: Sample and release basis

value.en: Approve tooling, first article, critical dimensions and mechanical/electrical evidence before repeat production.
value.zh: 重复生产前确认模具、首件、关键尺寸以及机械与电气证据。

question.zh: 模制尾套本身能证明防水吗？
question.en: Does a molded boot alone establish waterproofing?

answer.zh: 外部模制结构不能单独证明防水。定义尾套长度、外形、出线角度和附近固定点。
answer.en: External molded geometry alone does not establish sealing. Define boot length, profile, exit angle and nearby fixing points.

question.zh: 软硬材料交界为什么需要检查？
question.en: Why inspect the transition between soft and rigid materials?

answer.zh: 软硬材料交界处需检查弯折集中。按护套材料与目标弯曲条件选硬度和粘接方式。
answer.en: Check bend concentration at soft/hard material transitions. Select hardness and bonding for the jacket material and intended bending duty.

question.zh: 包胶工艺如何保护内部线缆和焊点？
question.en: How does molding protect the internal cable and joints?

answer.zh: 工艺温度不能损伤内部绝缘或焊点。嵌件支撑、分型位置和成型条件应保护内部端接。
answer.en: Process temperature must not damage internal insulation or solder joints. Insert support, parting lines and molding conditions should protect internal terminations.

introVariants.en: Custom PTFE-insulated wire and cable assemblies for high-temperature instruments, sensors, heaters and compact equipment, with defined materials, stripping, termination and inspection.
introVariants.zh: 面向高温仪器、传感器、加热设备与紧凑装置定制 PTFE 绝缘电线及电缆组件，明确材料、剥线、端接与检验要求。

introVariants.en: PTFE is a material family identifier, not a complete wire or termination specification.
introVariants.zh: PTFE 是材料体系标识，并不是完整的线材或端接规范。

text.zh: 线材、端子和套管分别核对使用温度与热源距离。
text.en: Check service temperature and heat-source clearance separately for wire, contacts and sleeves.

text.zh: 按PTFE绝缘尺寸安排剥皮、端接和近端固定。
text.en: Plan stripping, termination and near-end fixing around PTFE insulation dimensions.

text.zh: 材料选择以实际介质、温度和接触时间为依据。
text.en: Select materials for the actual medium, temperature and exposure duration.

text.zh: 加热设备端子引线可按项目需求评审。分别记录绝缘尺寸、温度条件与电压依据。
text.en: For heating-equipment terminal leads, review the project conditions. Record insulation dimensions, temperature conditions and voltage basis separately.

text.zh: 仪器内部端接可按项目需求评审。剥皮和端接工装需控制伤股、回缩与绝缘保持。
text.en: For internal instrument terminations, review the project conditions. Stripping and termination tooling must control strand damage, recession and insulation retention.

text.zh: 工艺传感器尾线可按项目需求评审。热缩、包胶与固定方式按材料相容和热条件评审。
text.en: For process-sensor pigtails, review the project conditions. Review heat-shrink, molding and fixing for material compatibility and thermal conditions.

text.zh: 用完整PTFE线材规格确认导体结构及绝缘材料。 PTFE类别名称不能证明具体额定温度。
text.en: Confirm conductor construction and insulation material from the full PTFE wire specification. The PTFE category name does not establish a temperature rating.

text.zh: 分别记录绝缘尺寸、温度条件与电压依据。 PTFE与其他含氟材料需按规格区分。
text.en: Record insulation dimensions, temperature conditions and voltage basis separately. Distinguish PTFE from other fluoropolymers by specification.

text.zh: 剥皮和端接工装需控制伤股、回缩与绝缘保持。 剥皮伤股和绝缘回缩需检查。
text.en: Stripping and termination tooling must control strand damage, recession and insulation retention. Inspect strand damage and insulation recession after stripping.

label.en: Full PTFE wire specification and conductor construction

value.zh: 用完整PTFE线材规格确认导体结构及绝缘材料。
value.en: Confirm conductor construction and insulation material from the full PTFE wire specification.

label.zh: 绝缘尺寸、温度与适用电压依据
label.en: Insulation dimensions, temperature and voltage evidence

value.zh: 分别记录绝缘尺寸、温度条件与电压依据。
value.en: Record insulation dimensions, temperature conditions and voltage basis separately.

label.zh: 剥皮工具、端接与绝缘保持
label.en: Stripping tool, termination and insulation retention

value.zh: 剥皮和端接工装需控制伤股、回缩与绝缘保持。
value.en: Stripping and termination tooling must control strand damage, recession and insulation retention.

label.zh: 热缩或包胶相容与固定方式
label.en: Heat-shrink/molding compatibility and fixing

value.zh: 热缩、包胶与固定方式按材料相容和热条件评审。
value.en: Review heat-shrink, molding and fixing for material compatibility and thermal conditions.

label.zh: 安装与使用边界
label.en: Installation and operating boundary

value.en: Provide the exact wire specification, conductor construction, terminal system, route, temperature zones and test requirements.
value.zh: 请提供准确线材规范、导体结构、端子体系、布线路径、温区及试验要求。

label.zh: 样品与放行依据
label.en: Sample and release basis

value.en: Approve materials, tooling, first article and controlled inspection evidence before repeat production.
value.zh: 重复生产前确认物料、工装、首件及受控检验证据。

question.zh: PTFE名称能确定使用温度吗？
question.en: Does the PTFE name define the service temperature?

answer.zh: PTFE类别名称不能证明具体额定温度。用完整PTFE线材规格确认导体结构及绝缘材料。
answer.en: The PTFE category name does not establish a temperature rating. Confirm conductor construction and insulation material from the full PTFE wire specification.

question.zh: 其他含氟绝缘能直接替代PTFE吗？
question.en: Can other fluoropolymer insulation directly replace PTFE?

answer.zh: PTFE与其他含氟材料需按规格区分。分别记录绝缘尺寸、温度条件与电压依据。
answer.en: Distinguish PTFE from other fluoropolymers by specification. Record insulation dimensions, temperature conditions and voltage basis separately.

question.zh: PTFE端接重点检查什么？
question.en: What needs particular attention in PTFE termination?

answer.zh: 剥皮伤股和绝缘回缩需检查。剥皮和端接工装需控制伤股、回缩与绝缘保持。
answer.en: Inspect strand damage and insulation recession after stripping. Stripping and termination tooling must control strand damage, recession and insulation retention.

avoidMisidentification.en: Inspect strand damage and insulation recession after stripping

introVariants.en: Custom IDC ribbon cable assemblies for board-to-board, panel and internal equipment connections with defined cable geometry, orientation, tooling and inspection.
introVariants.zh: 面向板间、面板及设备内部连接定制 IDC 扁平排线组件，明确线缆几何、方向、工装与检验要求。

introVariants.en: IDC is a termination method, not one universal connector or cable specification.
introVariants.zh: IDC 是端接方法，并不是一种通用接头或排线规范。

text.zh: 根据两个板端的视图、距离和插入方向确定排线。
text.en: Define the ribbon from both board-end views, spacing and insertion directions.

text.zh: 红边、极化缺口和1脚关系按装配图统一标识。
text.en: Align the marked edge, polarization notch and pin-one relationship on the assembly drawing.

text.zh: 分支和折返处分别检查针序及应力夹的位置。
text.en: Check pin order and strain-clamp positions at each branch and fold.

text.zh: 设备检修端口可按项目需求评审。带状线的芯数、线规和导体节距匹配连接器。
text.en: For equipment service ports, review the project conditions. Match ribbon conductor count, gauge and spacing to the connector.

text.zh: 模块延长连接可按项目需求评审。图纸明确红边、极化缺口和1脚在每一端的关系。
text.en: For module extension connections, review the project conditions. Show marked edge, polarization notch and pin one at every end.

text.zh: 机架板间连接可按项目需求评审。定位工装、压合行程与应力夹装配形成工艺要求。
text.en: For rack board interconnections, review the project conditions. Define location tooling, press travel and strain-clamp assembly in the process.

text.zh: IDC系列、连接器节距与针位视图成套确认。 线缆节距与连接器适配需核对。
text.en: Confirm the IDC family, connector pitch and cavity views together. Verify cable pitch against connector suitability.

text.zh: 带状线的芯数、线规和导体节距匹配连接器。 折返和分支会改变针序视图。
text.en: Match ribbon conductor count, gauge and spacing to the connector. Foldbacks and branches affect the pin-order view.

text.zh: 图纸明确红边、极化缺口和1脚在每一端的关系。 IDC接触不能按外观判定可靠压合。
text.en: Show marked edge, polarization notch and pin one at every end. Appearance alone does not establish a reliable IDC press.

label.en: IDC connector series, pitch and positions

value.zh: IDC系列、连接器节距与针位视图成套确认。
value.en: Confirm the IDC family, connector pitch and cavity views together.

label.en: Ribbon pitch, gauge and conductor count

value.zh: 带状线的芯数、线规和导体节距匹配连接器。
value.en: Match ribbon conductor count, gauge and spacing to the connector.
