label.en: Polarizing notch, red edge and pin-1 mapping

value.zh: 图纸明确红边、极化缺口和1脚在每一端的关系。
value.en: Show marked edge, polarization notch and pin one at every end.

label.zh: 压接工装、定位与应力夹
label.en: Press tooling, alignment and strain clamp

value.zh: 定位工装、压合行程与应力夹装配形成工艺要求。
value.en: Define location tooling, press travel and strain-clamp assembly in the process.

label.zh: 安装与使用边界
label.en: Installation and operating boundary

value.en: Provide the mating interface, pitch, circuit count, AWG, pin map, orientation, dimensions, route and test requirements.
value.zh: 请提供对插接口、节距、回路数、AWG、针脚表、方向、尺寸、路径与测试要求。

label.zh: 样品与放行依据
label.en: Sample and release basis

value.en: Approve cable, connectors, tooling, first-article orientation and continuity evidence before repeat production.
value.zh: 重复生产前确认排线、接头、工装、首件方向与导通证据。

question.zh: 线缆节距相同就能选任意IDC头吗？
question.en: Does matching cable spacing allow any IDC connector?

answer.zh: 线缆节距与连接器适配需核对。IDC系列、连接器节距与针位视图成套确认。
answer.en: Verify cable pitch against connector suitability. Confirm the IDC family, connector pitch and cavity views together.

question.zh: 折返和分支会影响针序吗？
question.en: Do folds and branches affect the pin-order view?

answer.zh: 折返和分支会改变针序视图。带状线的芯数、线规和导体节距匹配连接器。
answer.en: Foldbacks and branches affect the pin-order view. Match ribbon conductor count, gauge and spacing to the connector.

question.zh: 压合质量能只看外观吗？
question.en: Can IDC pressing quality be judged from appearance alone?

answer.zh: IDC接触不能按外观判定可靠压合。图纸明确红边、极化缺口和1脚在每一端的关系。
answer.en: Appearance alone does not establish a reliable IDC press. Show marked edge, polarization notch and pin one at every end.

avoidMisidentification.en: Verify cable pitch against connector suitability

avoidMisidentification.zh: 折返和分支会改变针序视图
avoidMisidentification.en: Foldbacks and branches affect the pin-order view

avoidMisidentification.zh: IDC接触不能按外观判定可靠压合
avoidMisidentification.en: Appearance alone does not establish a reliable IDC press

introVariants.en: Custom FFC and FPC cable assemblies for displays, cameras, control panels and compact equipment, with defined pitch, contact side, tail geometry, mating, routing and inspection.
introVariants.zh: 面向显示、摄像、控制面板与紧凑设备定制 FFC 和 FPC 电缆组件，明确节距、触点面、尾端几何、插接、布线与检验要求。

introVariants.en: FFC and FPC are related flexible interconnects, but their construction, thickness, copper geometry and connector compatibility are not interchangeable by name.
introVariants.zh: FFC 与 FPC 都属于柔性互连，但结构、厚度、铜路几何及接头兼容性不能仅凭名称互换。

text.zh: 核对两端接触面、插入方向及连接器锁止形式。
text.en: Check contact faces, insertion directions and connector locking at both ends.

text.zh: 厚度、补强板和弯曲区域必须适合壳体与插座。
text.en: Thickness, stiffeners and bending regions must suit the enclosure and receptacles.

text.zh: 若存在反复运动，应单独定义弯曲动作和验证条件。
text.en: Where motion repeats, define the bending motion and verification conditions separately.

text.zh: 显示模块插接位置可按项目需求评审。明确两端接触面同向或反向及实际插入视图。
text.en: For display-module connections, review the project conditions. Define same-side or opposite-side contacts and the actual insertion views.

text.zh: 成像模块内部连接可按项目需求评审。匹配总厚度、补强板和裸露接触长度。
text.en: For internal imaging-module connections, review the project conditions. Match total thickness, stiffeners and exposed-contact length.

text.zh: 薄型机壳跨板连接可按项目需求评审。将锁止空间、固定折弯和动态动作分别定义。
text.en: For cross-board links in low-profile enclosures, review the project conditions. Define locking clearance, fixed folds and dynamic motion separately.

text.zh: 先区分FPC或FFC，再确定节距与线路数。 FPC与FFC不是同一制造结构。
text.en: Distinguish FPC from FFC before defining pitch and circuit count. FPC and FFC are different manufacturing constructions.

text.zh: 明确两端接触面同向或反向及实际插入视图。 节距相同仍需匹配厚度和接触面。
text.en: Define same-side or opposite-side contacts and the actual insertion views. Equal pitch still requires matching thickness and contact orientation.

text.zh: 匹配总厚度、补强板和裸露接触长度。 动态折弯能力需专门设计验证。
text.en: Match total thickness, stiffeners and exposed-contact length. Dynamic flexing capability requires dedicated design verification.

label.zh: FPC或FFC类型、节距与线路数
label.en: FPC/FFC type, pitch and circuit count

value.zh: 先区分FPC或FFC，再确定节距与线路数。
value.en: Distinguish FPC from FFC before defining pitch and circuit count.

label.zh: 接触面同向或反向及插入方向
label.en: Same/opposite contact orientation and insertion direction

value.zh: 明确两端接触面同向或反向及实际插入视图。
value.en: Define same-side or opposite-side contacts and the actual insertion views.

label.zh: 厚度、补强板与裸露接触长度
label.en: Thickness, stiffener and exposed-contact length

value.zh: 匹配总厚度、补强板和裸露接触长度。
value.en: Match total thickness, stiffeners and exposed-contact length.

label.zh: 连接器锁止、弯曲和安装空间
label.en: Connector locking, bend and installation space

value.zh: 将锁止空间、固定折弯和动态动作分别定义。
value.en: Define locking clearance, fixed folds and dynamic motion separately.

label.zh: 安装与使用边界
label.en: Installation and operating boundary

value.en: Provide both endpoint references, pitch, circuits, contact-side views, tail dimensions, installed route, motion duty and inspection requirements.
value.zh: 请提供两端接口、节距、回路数、触点面视图、尾端尺寸、安装路径、运动工况与检验要求。

label.zh: 样品与放行依据
label.en: Sample and release basis

value.en: Approve the cable drawing, connector system, mating method, routing sample and electrical evidence before repeat production.
value.zh: 重复生产前确认线缆图纸、接头体系、对插方法、布线样品与电气证据。

question.zh: FPC和FFC属于同一种结构吗？
question.en: Are FPC and FFC the same construction?

answer.zh: FPC与FFC不是同一制造结构。先区分FPC或FFC，再确定节距与线路数。
answer.en: FPC and FFC are different manufacturing constructions. Distinguish FPC from FFC before defining pitch and circuit count.

question.zh: 相同节距是否足够确认适配？
question.en: Is equal pitch enough to confirm fit?

answer.zh: 节距相同仍需匹配厚度和接触面。明确两端接触面同向或反向及实际插入视图。
answer.en: Equal pitch still requires matching thickness and contact orientation. Define same-side or opposite-side contacts and the actual insertion views.

question.zh: 薄型排线都适合动态折弯吗？
question.en: Are all flat flexible cables suitable for dynamic bending?

answer.zh: 动态折弯能力需专门设计验证。匹配总厚度、补强板和裸露接触长度。
answer.en: Dynamic flexing capability requires dedicated design verification. Match total thickness, stiffeners and exposed-contact length.

avoidMisidentification.en: FPC and FFC are different manufacturing constructions

avoidMisidentification.zh: 节距相同仍需匹配厚度和接触面
avoidMisidentification.en: Equal pitch still requires matching thickness and contact orientation

avoidMisidentification.zh: 动态折弯能力需专门设计验证
avoidMisidentification.en: Dynamic flexing capability requires dedicated design verification

introVariants.en: Custom Micro-D cable assemblies for compact aerospace, defense, instrumentation, medical and industrial electronics, with defined interface, circuit map, cable construction, retention, shielding and inspection.
introVariants.zh: 面向紧凑型航空航天、国防、仪器、医疗及工业电子设备定制 Micro-D 电缆组件，明确接口、回路图、线缆结构、锁紧、屏蔽与检验要求。

introVariants.en: Micro-D identifies a miniature connector family, not a complete cable or qualification statement.
introVariants.zh: Micro-D 标识微型连接器家族，并不等于完整电缆规范或资质声明。

text.zh: 按壳号和接点布局安排针位与线缆出线。
text.en: Arrange cavity mapping and cable exits around shell size and contact layout.

text.zh: 微型端接后的绝缘间距和尾部支撑应保留检查空间。
text.en: Allow inspection of insulation spacing and rear support after miniature termination.

text.zh: 需要专用规范时，以准确料号和项目文件确定交付范围。
text.en: Where specialized specifications apply, define supply against exact part numbers and project documents.

text.zh: 数据采集模块端可按项目需求评审。按端面视图记录接点类型、公母及连接表。
text.en: For data-acquisition module ends, review the project conditions. Record contact type, gender and connection table from end-face views.

text.zh: 紧凑面板转接端可按项目需求评审。端接工艺、线规与后部支撑按具体接点定义。
text.en: For compact panel-adapter ends, review the project conditions. Define termination method, wire gauge and rear support for the specific contacts.

text.zh: 仪器探头线缆端可按项目需求评审。锁紧件、屏蔽及验收规范按项目文件逐项确认。
text.en: For instrument probe-cable ends, review the project conditions. Confirm fasteners, shielding and acceptance specifications against project documents.

text.zh: 核对Micro-D系列、壳号及完整插芯配置。 Micro-D不能与外形接近Mini-D混称。
text.en: Check the Micro-D family, shell size and complete insert configuration. Do not label look-alike Mini-D as Micro-D.

question.zh: Micro-D与Mini-D可以混称吗？
question.en: Can Micro-D and Mini-D names be used interchangeably?

answer.en: Do not label look-alike Mini-D as Micro-D. Check the Micro-D family, shell size and complete insert configuration.

question.zh: 分类名称能证明符合某项专用规范吗？
question.en: Does the category name establish compliance with a specialized specification?

answer.en: Specification claims need exact part numbers and documents. Record contact type, gender and connection table from end-face views.

question.zh: 微型焊接后要检查什么？
question.en: What should be checked after miniature solder termination?

answer.en: Inspect miniature solder joints and inter-contact insulation. Define termination method, wire gauge and rear support for the specific contacts.

introVariants.en: Custom panel-mount and bulkhead cable assemblies turn a cable end into a defined equipment interface, with the connector, cutout, hardware, seal, cable construction and validation engineered together.
introVariants.zh: 定制面板安装与隔板电缆组件，将线端变成边界清晰的设备接口，并将连接器、开孔、五金、密封、线缆结构与验证协同开发。

introVariants.en: Panel mounting describes installation, not signal capability, ingress protection or an interchangeable connector family.
introVariants.zh: 面板安装描述安装方式，并不自动代表信号能力、防护等级或通用接口。

text.zh: 开孔、板厚、固定方式和后方净空共同决定安装结构。
text.en: Cutout, panel thickness, fixing method and rear clearance define the installed construction.

text.zh: 区分前装与后装，并留出线缆入口和工具位置。
text.en: Distinguish front and rear mounting while allowing cable entry and tool access.

text.zh: 面板垫圈与连接器插合密封应分别定义验收边界。
text.en: Define panel-gasket and connector-mating sealing as separate acceptance boundaries.

text.zh: 控制箱开孔位置可按项目需求评审。指定前后安装方向、螺纹和固定件结构。
text.en: For control-box cutouts, review the project conditions. Specify mounting direction, threads and fastener construction.

text.zh: 机柜隔板接口可按项目需求评审。按垫圈材料与压缩量审查密封及接地位置。
text.en: For cabinet bulkhead interfaces, review the project conditions. Review sealing and grounding locations against gasket material and compression.

text.zh: 便携仪器面板端可按项目需求评审。出线角度、转接长度及拆装空间纳入尺寸确认。
text.en: For portable-instrument panel ends, review the project conditions. Include exit angle, adapter length and service access in dimensional approval.

text.zh: 提供面板厚度、公差、开孔及邻近安装包络。 连接器额定防护与面板密封分开验证。
text.en: Provide panel thickness, tolerance, cutout and nearby installation envelope. Validate connector protection separately from panel sealing.

text.zh: 指定前后安装方向、螺纹和固定件结构。 面板厚度影响螺纹咬合和密封压缩。
text.en: Specify mounting direction, threads and fastener construction. Panel thickness affects thread engagement and seal compression.

text.zh: 按垫圈材料与压缩量审查密封及接地位置。 安装扭矩需对应具体固定结构。
text.en: Review sealing and grounding locations against gasket material and compression. Mounting torque must match the actual fixing design.

value.en: Review sealing and grounding locations against gasket material and compression.

label.zh: 线缆出口、转接与维修空间
label.en: Cable exits, transitions and service clearance

value.zh: 出线角度、转接长度及拆装空间纳入尺寸确认。
value.en: Include exit angle, adapter length and service access in dimensional approval.

label.zh: 安装与使用边界
label.en: Installation and operating boundary

value.en: Provide the exact interface, panel material and thickness, cutout drawing, mounting side, hardware, route, environment and test requirements.
value.zh: 请提供准确接口、面板材料与厚度、开孔图、安装方向、紧固件、路径、环境及测试要求。

label.zh: 样品与放行依据
label.en: Sample and release basis

value.en: Approve mechanical fit, interface sample, sealing stack, circuit map and project-specific test evidence before repeat production.
value.zh: 重复生产前确认机械配合、接口样件、密封叠层、回路图及项目特定测试证据。

question.zh: 连接器防护额定能证明面板密封吗？
question.en: Does the connector protection rating establish panel sealing?

answer.zh: 连接器额定防护与面板密封分开验证。提供面板厚度、公差、开孔及邻近安装包络。
answer.en: Validate connector protection separately from panel sealing. Provide panel thickness, tolerance, cutout and nearby installation envelope.

question.zh: 面板厚度为什么影响安装？
question.en: Why does panel thickness affect installation?

answer.zh: 面板厚度影响螺纹咬合和密封压缩。指定前后安装方向、螺纹和固定件结构。
answer.en: Panel thickness affects thread engagement and seal compression. Specify mounting direction, threads and fastener construction.

question.zh: 固定螺母可以使用通用扭矩吗？
question.en: Can mounting nuts use one universal torque?

answer.zh: 安装扭矩需对应具体固定结构。按垫圈材料与压缩量审查密封及接地位置。
answer.en: Mounting torque must match the actual fixing design. Review sealing and grounding locations against gasket material and compression.

introVariants.en: Custom waterproof wire harnesses are developed as complete sealed systems around the real exposure, mating state, cable entries, branches and agreed validation.
introVariants.zh: 定制防水设计线束需要围绕真实暴露、插合状态、出线、分支与约定验证，作为完整密封系统开发。

introVariants.en: IP67, IP68 and IP69K are different defined test questions; a component rating does not automatically transfer to a complete harness.
introVariants.zh: IP67、IP68 与 IP69K 对应不同规定试验，元件等级不会自动转移到完整线束。

text.zh: 把插合口、线缆入口和接头位置绘成完整密封边界。
text.en: Map mating interfaces, cable entries and joints as a complete sealing boundary.

text.zh: 按雨水、积水、姿态与温度变化确定需要验证的条件。
text.en: Define validation conditions for rain, pooling water, orientation and temperature changes.

text.zh: 说明未插合时如何防护，以及检修后的重新密封要求。
text.en: Define protection while unmated and the resealing requirements after service.

text.zh: 设备线缆入口可按项目需求评审。线封、灌封、垫圈与壳体按材料相容性配套。
text.en: For equipment cable entries, review the project conditions. Match wire seals, potting, gaskets and housings for material compatibility.

text.zh: 需要清洁的连接区可按项目需求评审。实际线缆外径、空孔和潜在毛细通道均须记录。
text.en: For connections in cleaning zones, review the project conditions. Record actual cable diameter, unused cavities and potential capillary paths.

text.zh: 户外可拆模块端可按项目需求评审。规定插合状态、安装姿态、温度循环及冷凝边界。
text.en: For detachable outdoor-module ends, review the project conditions. Specify mating state, installation orientation, temperature cycling and condensation conditions.

text.zh: 目标防护要求应包含完整组件边界与具体试验条件。 防水结构照片不构成IP证明。
text.en: Protection targets must identify the full assembly boundary and exact test conditions. Waterproof-looking geometry is not IP evidence.

text.zh: 线封、灌封、垫圈与壳体按材料相容性配套。 胶封固化与材料相容需有工艺依据。
text.en: Match wire seals, potting, gaskets and housings for material compatibility. Potting cure and compatibility require process evidence.

text.zh: 实际线缆外径、空孔和潜在毛细通道均须记录。 未插合、透气与冷凝条件另行定义。
text.en: Record actual cable diameter, unused cavities and potential capillary paths. Define unmated, venting and condensation conditions separately.

label.en: Full-assembly sealing boundary and target test

value.zh: 目标防护要求应包含完整组件边界与具体试验条件。
value.en: Protection targets must identify the full assembly boundary and exact test conditions.

value.en: Record actual cable diameter, unused cavities and potential capillary paths.

label.en: Mating state, orientation and thermal cycling

value.zh: 规定插合状态、安装姿态、温度循环及冷凝边界。
value.en: Specify mating state, installation orientation, temperature cycling and condensation conditions.

label.en: Installation and operating boundary

value.en: Provide both mating interfaces, pin map, cable diameters, unused cavities, orientation, exposure, movement and required test method.
value.zh: 请提供对插两端、针脚表、线缆外径、空腔、方向、暴露、运动与所需试验方法。

label.zh: 样品与放行依据
label.en: Sample and release basis

value.en: Release records the sealing stack, preparation dimensions, assembly controls and project-specific evidence.
value.zh: 放行记录密封链、备线尺寸、装配控制与项目特定证据。

question.zh: 防水结构照片能证明IP等级吗？
question.en: Does a photograph of sealed construction establish an IP rating?

answer.zh: 防水结构照片不构成IP证明。目标防护要求应包含完整组件边界与具体试验条件。
answer.en: Waterproof-looking geometry is not IP evidence. Protection targets must identify the full assembly boundary and exact test conditions.

question.zh: 胶封需要哪些工艺条件？
question.en: Which process conditions are needed for potting?

answer.zh: 胶封固化与材料相容需有工艺依据。线封、灌封、垫圈与壳体按材料相容性配套。
answer.en: Potting cure and compatibility require process evidence. Match wire seals, potting, gaskets and housings for material compatibility.

question.zh: 未插合与冷凝条件怎样处理？
question.en: How are unmated and condensation conditions handled?

answer.zh: 未插合、透气与冷凝条件另行定义。实际线缆外径、空孔和潜在毛细通道均须记录。
answer.en: Define unmated, venting and condensation conditions separately. Record actual cable diameter, unused cavities and potential capillary paths.

introVariants.en: Custom FTDI cable assemblies combine USB conversion electronics, a defined serial electrical layer, purpose-built endpoints and project-specific validation.
introVariants.zh: 定制 FTDI 电缆组件将 USB 转换电子器件、明确串行电气层、专用端点与项目特定验证结合起来。

introVariants.en: An FTDI cable is an active electronic assembly; connector appearance does not prove protocol, voltage, pinout or driver identity.
introVariants.zh: FTDI 线属于有源电子组件，接口外观不能证明协议、电平、针脚或驱动身份。

text.zh: 先确定设备侧电平、针位与供电，再匹配主机接口。
text.en: Define equipment-side levels, pins and power before matching the host interface.

text.zh: 将USB枚举、驱动环境和目标设备识别要求一起确认。
text.en: Confirm USB enumeration, driver environment and target-device identification together.

text.zh: 实际通信验证应覆盖主机系统、串口参数和目标设备。
text.en: Communication checks should include the host system, serial settings and target device.

text.zh: USB主机连接端可按项目需求评审。明确TTL、RS232或RS485设备侧接口及电平。
text.en: For usb host connections, review the project conditions. Define the TTL, RS232 or RS485 equipment-side interface and levels.

text.zh: 设备串口模块端可按项目需求评审。记录USB枚举、驱动版本及设备识别配置。
text.en: For equipment serial-module ends, review the project conditions. Record USB enumeration, driver versions and device-identification settings.

text.zh: 调试供电与信号端可按项目需求评审。图纸定义串口针脚、供电方向及是否需要隔离。
text.en: For commissioning power and signal ends, review the project conditions. Define serial pins, power direction and any isolation requirement on the drawing.

text.zh: 指定FTDI芯片或模块的完整型号及允许供货来源。 TTL电平、RS232和RS485不可互接。
text.en: Specify the complete FTDI chip or module model and permitted supply sources. Do not interconnect TTL, RS232 and RS485 directly.

text.zh: 明确TTL、RS232或RS485设备侧接口及电平。 来源型号不证明原厂芯片或授权。
text.en: Define the TTL, RS232 or RS485 equipment-side interface and levels. A source model does not establish original silicon or authorization.

text.zh: 记录USB枚举、驱动版本及设备识别配置。 目标系统驱动与通信需实机验证。
text.en: Record USB enumeration, driver versions and device-identification settings. Validate drivers and communication on the target system.

label.en: Sample and release basis

value.zh: 放行文件记录电子器件、编程配置、线缆 BOM、端点、回路图、标签及约定的被动与有源测试。

question.zh: TTL、RS232与RS485可以互接吗？
question.en: Can TTL, RS232 and RS485 be connected interchangeably?

answer.zh: TTL电平、RS232和RS485不可互接。指定FTDI芯片或模块的完整型号及允许供货来源。
answer.en: Do not interconnect TTL, RS232 and RS485 directly. Specify the complete FTDI chip or module model and permitted supply sources.

question.zh: 接口名称能证明芯片来源吗？
question.en: Does the interface name establish chip provenance?

answer.zh: 来源型号不证明原厂芯片或授权。明确TTL、RS232或RS485设备侧接口及电平。
answer.en: A source model does not establish original silicon or authorization. Define the TTL, RS232 or RS485 equipment-side interface and levels.

question.zh: 导通合格是否代表通信一定正常？
question.en: Does continuity acceptance ensure successful communication?

answer.zh: 目标系统驱动与通信需实机验证。记录USB枚举、驱动版本及设备识别配置。
answer.en: Validate drivers and communication on the target system. Record USB enumeration, driver versions and device-identification settings.

introVariants.en: Custom EMI-shielded cable assemblies coordinate cable geometry, foil or braid, connector termination, bonding, ferrites and defined validation around the real noise source and coupling path.
introVariants.zh: 定制 EMI 屏蔽电缆组件围绕真实噪声源与耦合路径，协同定义线缆几何、铝箔或编织、连接器端接、搭接、铁氧体与验证。

introVariants.en: Shielding is a system path; coverage, endpoint continuity, enclosure bonding, routing and frequency determine performance.
introVariants.zh: 屏蔽是一条系统路径，覆盖、端点连续性、机壳搭接、走线与频率共同决定性能。

text.zh: 按干扰源、信号幅度和接地结构确定屏蔽路径。
text.en: Define the shield path from interference sources, signal levels and grounding construction.

text.zh: 将线缆路径、壳体连接和端接区解绞长度一起审核。
text.en: Review routing, housing bonding and untwist length at terminations together.

text.zh: 连续屏蔽不能只停在线材上，接口和尾壳也需配套。
text.en: Shield continuity requires matching interfaces and backshells as well as shielded cable.

text.zh: 精密仪器连接端可按项目需求评审。按项目选择箔层、编织、排流线及分对屏蔽。
text.en: For precision instrument connections, review the project conditions. Select foil, braid, drain wires and pair shields for the project.

text.zh: 屏蔽面板转接端可按项目需求评审。壳体端接、接地位置与360度连接按系统设计确定。
text.en: For shielded panel-adapter ends, review the project conditions. Define housing termination, grounding points and 360-degree bonding through the system design.

text.zh: 电机控制器附近配线可按项目需求评审。分别约定屏蔽连续性检查与整机EMC验证。
text.en: For wiring near motor controllers, review the project conditions. Agree shield-continuity checks and equipment EMC validation separately.

text.zh: 先明确干扰频段、敏感信号及需要解决的耦合路径。 屏蔽外观不能证明EMC通过。
text.en: Define interference bands, sensitive signals and the coupling path to address. Shielded appearance does not establish EMC compliance.

text.zh: 按项目选择箔层、编织、排流线及分对屏蔽。 一端或两端接地依据系统设计。
text.en: Select foil, braid, drain wires and pair shields for the project. Use the system design to select single/both-end grounding.

text.zh: 壳体端接、接地位置与360度连接按系统设计确定。 组件屏蔽性能与整机EMC分开确认。
text.en: Define housing termination, grounding points and 360-degree bonding through the system design. Confirm assembly shielding separately from equipment EMC.

label.zh: 干扰频段、敏感信号与屏蔽目标
label.en: Interference bands, sensitive signals and shielding target

value.zh: 先明确干扰频段、敏感信号及需要解决的耦合路径。
value.en: Define interference bands, sensitive signals and the coupling path to address.

label.zh: 箔层、编织、排流线与覆盖配置
label.en: Foil, braid, drain and coverage configuration

value.zh: 按项目选择箔层、编织、排流线及分对屏蔽。
value.en: Select foil, braid, drain wires and pair shields for the project.

label.zh: 壳体360度端接或其他接地结构
label.en: 360-degree shell termination or other grounding arrangement

value.zh: 壳体端接、接地位置与360度连接按系统设计确定。
value.en: Define housing termination, grounding points and 360-degree bonding through the system design.

label.zh: 屏蔽连续性与EMC试验计划
label.en: Shield continuity and EMC test plan

value.zh: 分别约定屏蔽连续性检查与整机EMC验证。
value.en: Agree shield-continuity checks and equipment EMC validation separately.

label.zh: 安装与使用边界
label.en: Installation and operating boundary

value.en: Provide the source, victim circuit, frequency range, interfaces, route, grounding architecture, environment and target test method.
value.zh: 请提供噪声源、受扰回路、频率范围、接口、走线、接地架构、环境与目标测试方法。

label.zh: 样品与放行依据
label.en: Sample and release basis

value.en: Release records pair geometry, shield construction, endpoint termination, ferrite details, grounding notes and agreed inspection or EMC evidence.
value.zh: 放行文件记录线对几何、屏蔽结构、端点端接、铁氧体细节、接地说明与约定检验或 EMC 证据。

question.zh: 有编织屏蔽就说明EMC通过了吗？
question.en: Does a braided shield establish an EMC pass?

answer.zh: 屏蔽外观不能证明EMC通过。先明确干扰频段、敏感信号及需要解决的耦合路径。
answer.en: Shielded appearance does not establish EMC compliance. Define interference bands, sensitive signals and the coupling path to address.

question.zh: 屏蔽层一定两端接地吗？
question.en: Must every shield be grounded at both ends?

answer.zh: 一端或两端接地依据系统设计。按项目选择箔层、编织、排流线及分对屏蔽。
answer.en: Use the system design to select single/both-end grounding. Select foil, braid, drain wires and pair shields for the project.

question.zh: 组件屏蔽检查能替代整机EMC吗？
question.en: Can assembly shield checks replace equipment EMC testing?

answer.zh: 组件屏蔽性能与整机EMC分开确认。壳体端接、接地位置与360度连接按系统设计确定。
answer.en: Confirm assembly shielding separately from equipment EMC. Define housing termination, grounding points and 360-degree bonding through the system design.

avoidMisidentification.zh: 屏蔽外观不能证明EMC通过
avoidMisidentification.en: Shielded appearance does not establish EMC compliance

avoidMisidentification.zh: 一端或两端接地依据系统设计
avoidMisidentification.en: Use the system design to select single/both-end grounding

avoidMisidentification.zh: 组件屏蔽性能与整机EMC分开确认
avoidMisidentification.en: Confirm assembly shielding separately from equipment EMC

introVariants.en: Custom ultrasonic-welded branch harnesses combine specified conductors into compact solid-state splices through a validated preparation, tooling, parameter, protection and inspection process.
introVariants.zh: 定制超声波焊接分支线束通过经过验证的备线、工装、参数、防护与检验工艺，把规定导体组合成紧凑固相焊点。

introVariants.en: The released weld window belongs to the exact wire combination, tooling and equipment; a material or size change requires review.
introVariants.zh: 放行焊接窗口属于准确线材组合、工装与设备，更换材料或线径需要重新审核。

text.zh: 先确定每支路材质、截面组合及连接功能。
text.en: Define each branch material, conductor-area combination and joint function first.

text.zh: 焊接区尺寸、布置位置和后续绝缘共同影响装配空间。
text.en: Joint dimensions, location and subsequent insulation together affect assembly clearance.

text.zh: 接头负载、固定点和绝缘防护分别确定验收要求。
text.en: Define acceptance separately for joint loading, fixing points and insulation protection.

text.zh: 电池支路汇接位置可按项目需求评审。确认接头几何、压缩尺寸和后续绝缘边界。
text.en: For battery-branch joint positions, review the project conditions. Confirm joint geometry, compressed dimensions and subsequent insulation boundaries.

text.zh: 设备共用回路分支可按项目需求评审。焊机、工装及工艺窗口须对应实际材料组合。
text.en: For shared equipment-circuit branches, review the project conditions. Match the welder, tooling and process window to the actual material combination.

text.zh: 传感器线束汇接位置可按项目需求评审。按项目确定拉力、电阻及截面检查方法。
text.en: For sensor-harness joint positions, review the project conditions. Define pull, resistance and cross-section checks for the project.

text.zh: 记录导体材质、各支路截面和焊接组合。 焊点照片不能证明超声波工艺。
text.en: Record conductor materials, individual branch areas and the welding combination. A joint photo does not establish ultrasonic welding.

text.zh: 确认接头几何、压缩尺寸和后续绝缘边界。 铜铝或异材组合需专用工艺依据。
text.en: Confirm joint geometry, compressed dimensions and subsequent insulation boundaries. Copper/aluminum or dissimilar joints need dedicated process evidence.

text.zh: 焊机、工装及工艺窗口须对应实际材料组合。 接头负载和绝缘防护分开检验。
text.en: Match the welder, tooling and process window to the actual material combination. Inspect joint load capability separately from insulation protection.

label.zh: 焊接导体材质、截面组合与支路
label.en: Weld conductor material, area combination and branches

value.zh: 记录导体材质、各支路截面和焊接组合。
value.en: Record conductor materials, individual branch areas and the welding combination.

label.zh: 接头几何、压缩尺寸与绝缘
label.en: Joint geometry, compressed dimensions and insulation

value.zh: 确认接头几何、压缩尺寸和后续绝缘边界。
value.en: Confirm joint geometry, compressed dimensions and subsequent insulation boundaries.

label.zh: 焊机、工装及工艺窗口
label.en: Welder, tooling and process window

value.zh: 焊机、工装及工艺窗口须对应实际材料组合。
value.en: Match the welder, tooling and process window to the actual material combination.

label.zh: 拉力、电阻及截面检查方法
label.en: Pull, resistance and section-inspection methods

value.zh: 按项目确定拉力、电阻及截面检查方法。
value.en: Define pull, resistance and cross-section checks for the project.

label.zh: 安装与使用边界
label.en: Installation and operating boundary

value.en: Provide every wire material and area, circuit, branch geometry, strip and protection needs, environment, standard, quantity and validation limits.
value.zh: 请提供每根线材与截面积、回路、分支几何、剥线和防护、环境、标准、数量与验证限值。

label.zh: 样品与放行依据
label.en: Sample and release basis

value.en: Release records wire stack, preparation, nugget limits, tooling, machine, parameter window, protection and inspection evidence.
value.zh: 放行文件记录线材叠放、备线、焊点限值、工装、设备、参数窗口、防护与检验证据。

question.zh: 焊点照片能确认使用超声波工艺吗？
question.en: Does a joint photograph establish ultrasonic processing?

answer.zh: 焊点照片不能证明超声波工艺。记录导体材质、各支路截面和焊接组合。
answer.en: A joint photo does not establish ultrasonic welding. Record conductor materials, individual branch areas and the welding combination.

question.zh: 铜铝组合可以沿用铜线焊接工艺吗？
question.en: Can copper-aluminium combinations use the copper-wire welding process?

answer.zh: 铜铝或异材组合需专用工艺依据。确认接头几何、压缩尺寸和后续绝缘边界。
answer.en: Copper/aluminum or dissimilar joints need dedicated process evidence. Confirm joint geometry, compressed dimensions and subsequent insulation boundaries.

question.zh: 焊接质量检查包含绝缘防护吗？
question.en: Do weld-quality checks also define insulation protection?

answer.zh: 接头负载和绝缘防护分开检验。焊机、工装及工艺窗口须对应实际材料组合。
answer.en: Inspect joint load capability separately from insulation protection. Match the welder, tooling and process window to the actual material combination.

avoidMisidentification.zh: 焊点照片不能证明超声波工艺
avoidMisidentification.en: A joint photo does not establish ultrasonic welding

avoidMisidentification.zh: 铜铝或异材组合需专用工艺依据
avoidMisidentification.en: Copper/aluminum or dissimilar joints need dedicated process evidence

avoidMisidentification.zh: 接头负载和绝缘防护分开检验
avoidMisidentification.en: Inspect joint load capability separately from insulation protection

introVariants.en: Custom spiral coiled cable assemblies balance retracted package, working extension, restoring force, cable construction, endpoints and a defined motion cycle.
introVariants.zh: 定制螺旋卷线电缆组件需要平衡收缩包络、工作拉伸、回弹力、线缆结构、端点与明确动作循环。

introVariants.en: A coiled cord is a complete moving cable system; extension ratio, force and life cannot be selected independently.
introVariants.zh: 卷线是一套完整运动线缆系统，拉伸倍率、作用力与寿命不能相互独立选择。

text.zh: 以正常工作距离和设备受力定义拉伸与回收状态。
text.en: Define extension and recovery from normal working reach and equipment loading.

text.zh: 收缩包络、圈径和直尾方向要适合台架运动空间。
text.en: Retracted envelope, coil diameter and tail direction must suit the bench motion space.

text.zh: 将回弹力、固定位置与端接保护作为一个运动系统确认。
text.en: Confirm restoring force, fixing positions and termination protection as one moving system.

text.zh: 操作手柄卷线可按项目需求评审。确定螺旋方向、直尾长度及两端出线方向。
text.en: For control-pendant coiled leads, review the project conditions. Define coil direction, straight-tail lengths and both cable exits.

text.zh: 可移动模块连接可按项目需求评审。导体与护套结构按回复力和工况共同选择。
text.en: For movable-module connections, review the project conditions. Select conductor and jacket construction for restoring force and operating duty together.

text.zh: 台架探头伸缩引线可按项目需求评审。注明伸缩频率、循环目标和两端固定条件。
text.en: For extensible bench-probe leads, review the project conditions. Specify extension frequency, cycle target and fixing conditions at both ends.

text.zh: 分别记录收缩长度、正常工作伸长和圈径。 最大拉伸长度不等于长期工作长度。
text.en: Record retracted length, normal working extension and coil diameter separately. Maximum extension is not the continuous working length.

text.zh: 确定螺旋方向、直尾长度及两端出线方向。 卷绕外观不能证明耐伸缩寿命。
text.en: Define coil direction, straight-tail lengths and both cable exits. Coiled appearance does not establish extension-cycle life.

text.zh: 导体与护套结构按回复力和工况共同选择。 伸缩应力不得直接传至端子。
text.en: Select conductor and jacket construction for restoring force and operating duty together. Do not transfer extension strain directly to terminals.

label.zh: 收缩长度、工作伸长与圈径
label.en: Retracted length, working extension and coil diameter

value.zh: 分别记录收缩长度、正常工作伸长和圈径。
value.en: Record retracted length, normal working extension and coil diameter separately.

label.zh: 螺旋方向、直尾长度与端头方向
label.en: Coil hand, straight-tail length and end orientation

value.zh: 确定螺旋方向、直尾长度及两端出线方向。
value.en: Define coil direction, straight-tail lengths and both cable exits.

label.zh: 导体、护套及回复力条件
label.en: Conductor, jacket and retraction-force conditions

value.zh: 导体与护套结构按回复力和工况共同选择。
value.en: Select conductor and jacket construction for restoring force and operating duty together.

label.zh: 伸缩频率、循环目标与固定方式
label.en: Extension frequency, cycle target and fixing

value.zh: 注明伸缩频率、循环目标和两端固定条件。
value.en: Specify extension frequency, cycle target and fixing conditions at both ends.

label.zh: 安装与使用边界
label.en: Installation and operating boundary

value.en: Provide retracted and working dimensions, coil geometry, both endpoints, circuits, restoring force, environment and motion profile.
value.zh: 请提供收缩与工作尺寸、线圈几何、两端接口、回路、回弹力、环境与动作谱。

label.zh: 样品与放行依据
label.en: Sample and release basis

value.en: Release records the cable build, coil dimensions, tail directions, endpoints, forming conditions and agreed dimensional, electrical and cycle evidence.
value.zh: 放行文件记录线缆结构、线圈尺寸、尾段方向、端点、成型条件与约定的尺寸、电气及循环证据。

question.zh: 最大拉伸长度等于长期工作长度吗？
question.en: Is maximum extension the same as long-term working reach?

answer.zh: 最大拉伸长度不等于长期工作长度。分别记录收缩长度、正常工作伸长和圈径。
answer.en: Maximum extension is not the continuous working length. Record retracted length, normal working extension and coil diameter separately.

question.zh: 卷绕外观能证明循环寿命吗？
question.en: Does coil appearance establish cycle life?

answer.zh: 卷绕外观不能证明耐伸缩寿命。确定螺旋方向、直尾长度及两端出线方向。
answer.en: Coiled appearance does not establish extension-cycle life. Define coil direction, straight-tail lengths and both cable exits.

question.zh: 卷线拉力可以直接由端子承受吗？
question.en: Can the terminals directly carry the coiled-cord tension?

answer.zh: 伸缩应力不得直接传至端子。导体与护套结构按回复力和工况共同选择。
answer.en: Do not transfer extension strain directly to terminals. Select conductor and jacket construction for restoring force and operating duty together.

avoidMisidentification.zh: 最大拉伸长度不等于长期工作长度
avoidMisidentification.en: Maximum extension is not the continuous working length

avoidMisidentification.zh: 卷绕外观不能证明耐伸缩寿命
avoidMisidentification.en: Coiled appearance does not establish extension-cycle life

avoidMisidentification.zh: 伸缩应力不得直接传至端子
avoidMisidentification.en: Do not transfer extension strain directly to terminals

introVariants.en: Custom high-temperature overmolded cable assemblies coordinate the conductor system, insulation, connector or sensor insert, molding material, process temperature, sealing geometry and validation around the real thermal profile.
introVariants.zh: 定制高温包覆成型电缆组件围绕真实温度谱，协同定义导体体系、绝缘、连接器或传感器嵌件、成型材料、工艺温度、密封几何与验证。

introVariants.en: High temperature is not one material label. Continuous exposure, short peaks, thermal cycling, current-generated heat, fluids and the molding process itself can create different failure modes.
introVariants.zh: 高温不是一个材料标签。持续暴露、短时峰值、冷热循环、电流自发热、介质以及成型工艺本身，会产生不同失效模式。

text.zh: 先核对内部器件和绝缘允许条件，再确定包覆材料。
text.en: Check internal component and insulation limits before choosing molding material.

text.zh: 持续温度、短时峰值和热循环需要分开定义。
text.en: Define continuous temperature, short peaks and thermal cycles separately.

text.zh: 成型结构应兼顾固定、密封和热胀后的受力变化。
text.en: Molded construction should account for fixing, sealing and load changes after thermal expansion.

text.zh: 加热装置接头区域可按项目需求评审。内部线缆、端子与器件逐项核对温度边界。
text.en: For heating-unit connection zones, review the project conditions. Check temperature limits for the internal cable, contacts and components individually.

title.en: Cable exits in heated equipment zones

text.zh: 热区设备线缆出口可按项目需求评审。定义成型温度、压力、时间及嵌件保护方法。
text.en: For cable exits in heated equipment zones, review the project conditions. Define molding temperature, pressure, time and insert-protection methods.

text.zh: 高温测量端接区域可按项目需求评审。约定热老化、热循环后的粘接和机械检验。
text.en: For high-temperature measurement terminations, review the project conditions. Agree bonding and mechanical checks after thermal aging and cycling.

text.zh: 按实际材料牌号记录成型条件和使用温度依据。 成型温度与长期使用温度是两项参数。
text.en: Record molding conditions and service-temperature evidence for the actual material grade. Molding temperature and continuous service temperature are different parameters.

text.zh: 内部线缆、端子与器件逐项核对温度边界。 高温材料不能自动提升内部器件额定。
text.en: Check temperature limits for the internal cable, contacts and components individually. High-temperature material does not raise internal component ratings.

text.zh: 定义成型温度、压力、时间及嵌件保护方法。 热循环后的密封和应力需验证。
text.en: Define molding temperature, pressure, time and insert-protection methods. Validate sealing and strain behavior after thermal cycling.

label.zh: 实际成型材料与温度规格
label.en: Actual molding material and temperature specification

value.zh: 按实际材料牌号记录成型条件和使用温度依据。
value.en: Record molding conditions and service-temperature evidence for the actual material grade.

label.zh: 内部线缆、端子与器件温度边界
label.en: Internal cable, terminal and device thermal limits

value.zh: 内部线缆、端子与器件逐项核对温度边界。
value.en: Check temperature limits for the internal cable, contacts and components individually.

label.zh: 成型温压、时间与嵌件保护
label.en: Molding temperature/pressure/time and insert protection

value.zh: 定义成型温度、压力、时间及嵌件保护方法。
value.en: Define molding temperature, pressure, time and insert-protection methods.

label.zh: 热老化、粘接和机械试验
label.en: Heat aging, adhesion and mechanical tests

value.zh: 约定热老化、热循环后的粘接和机械检验。
value.en: Agree bonding and mechanical checks after thermal aging and cycling.

label.zh: 安装与使用边界
label.en: Installation and operating boundary

value.en: Provide the operating and peak temperatures at every zone, dwell and cycle profile, cable and insert materials, circuits, fluids, sealing target, mounting and required test method.
value.zh: 请提供各温区工作与峰值温度、停留与循环谱、线缆和嵌件材料、回路、介质、密封目标、安装与所需试验方法。

label.zh: 样品与放行依据
label.en: Sample and release basis

value.en: Release records the material identities, preconditioning, tooling, process window, critical dimensions and agreed electrical, mechanical, sealing and thermal evidence.
value.zh: 放行文件记录材料身份、预处理、工装、工艺窗口、关键尺寸与约定的电气、机械、密封及热学证据。

question.zh: 成型温度就是长期使用温度吗？
question.en: Is molding temperature the same as long-term service temperature?

answer.zh: 成型温度与长期使用温度是两项参数。按实际材料牌号记录成型条件和使用温度依据。
answer.en: Molding temperature and continuous service temperature are different parameters. Record molding conditions and service-temperature evidence for the actual material grade.

question.zh: 耐高温包胶能提升内部器件额定吗？

answer.en: High-temperature material does not raise internal component ratings. Check temperature limits for the internal cable, contacts and components individually.

question.zh: 热循环后为什么还需检查密封和应力？
question.en: Why check sealing and strain after thermal cycling?

answer.zh: 热循环后的密封和应力需验证。定义成型温度、压力、时间及嵌件保护方法。
answer.en: Validate sealing and strain behavior after thermal cycling. Define molding temperature, pressure, time and insert-protection methods.

introVariants.en: Custom low-pressure molding integrates a defined electronic or cable insert with a thermoplastic protective body while controlling component exposure, interfaces, tooling contact and the complete assembly validation plan.
introVariants.zh: 定制低压成型把规定的电子或线缆嵌件与热塑性保护体整合，同时控制元件承受、接口边界、工装接触及完整组件验证计划。

introVariants.en: Low pressure describes a process approach, not an automatic guarantee of electronics safety, sealing or service life. Resin, insert, geometry and process window must be reviewed together.
introVariants.zh: 低压描述的是一种工艺路径，并不自动保证电子元件安全、密封或使用寿命；树脂、嵌件、几何与工艺窗口必须一起审核。

text.zh: 明确需要包覆和保留外露的区域，避免影响接口与维修。
text.en: Define encapsulated and exposed regions so interfaces and service access remain usable.

text.zh: 包覆厚度、灌注路径和线缆入口应适合实际接点结构。
text.en: Match encapsulation thickness, fill paths and cable entries to the joint construction.

text.zh: 材料与器件相容性、热影响及空洞检查形成工艺边界。
text.en: Set process boundaries through material compatibility, heat exposure and void inspection.

text.zh: 电路板线缆出口可按项目需求评审。图纸定义包覆边界、壁厚、腔体和需保护区域。
text.en: For circuit-board cable exits, review the project conditions. Define encapsulation boundaries, wall thickness, cavities and protected regions on the drawing.

text.zh: 传感器壳内连接可按项目需求评审。按器件限制确定温度、压力及灌注路径。
text.en: For connections inside sensor housings, review the project conditions. Set temperature, pressure and fill paths within component limits.

text.zh: 电缆分支包覆区域可按项目需求评审。分别约定电气、粘接、空洞与环境检查方法。
text.en: For cable-branch encapsulation zones, review the project conditions. Agree electrical, bonding, void and environmental checks separately.

text.zh: 选择准确材料牌号并核对护套及器件相容性。 低压不等于对所有器件无损。
text.en: Select the exact material grade and check jacket and component compatibility. Low pressure does not establish harmlessness to every component.

text.zh: 图纸定义包覆边界、壁厚、腔体和需保护区域。 包覆结构需区分可维修与不可维修。
text.en: Define encapsulation boundaries, wall thickness, cavities and protected regions on the drawing. Distinguish repairable and non-repairable encapsulation.

text.zh: 按器件限制确定温度、压力及灌注路径。 材料牌号资料不能替代组件验证。
text.en: Set temperature, pressure and fill paths within component limits. Material-grade data does not replace assembly validation.

question.zh: 低压成型对所有器件都无损吗？
question.en: Is low-pressure molding harmless to every component?

answer.zh: 低压不等于对所有器件无损。选择准确材料牌号并核对护套及器件相容性。
answer.en: Low pressure does not establish harmlessness to every component. Select the exact material grade and check jacket and component compatibility.

question.zh: 包覆后还能维修吗？
question.en: Can the assembly be serviced after encapsulation?

answer.zh: 包覆结构需区分可维修与不可维修。图纸定义包覆边界、壁厚、腔体和需保护区域。
answer.en: Distinguish repairable and non-repairable encapsulation. Define encapsulation boundaries, wall thickness, cavities and protected regions on the drawing.

question.zh: 材料资料能替代成品验证吗？
question.en: Can material data replace finished-assembly validation?

answer.zh: 材料牌号资料不能替代组件验证。按器件限制确定温度、压力及灌注路径。
answer.en: Material-grade data does not replace assembly validation. Set temperature, pressure and fill paths within component limits.

introVariants.en: Automotive primary wire is selected by circuit, route, installation zone, terminal system and governing specification rather than colour or nominal gauge alone.
introVariants.zh: 汽车电线应依据回路、路径、安装温区、端子系统和适用规范选择，不能只看颜色或标称线径。

introVariants.en: SAE J1128, the ISO 19642 series and customer specifications define different construction and validation frameworks. The exact type and revision must be identified for each project.
introVariants.zh: SAE J1128、ISO 19642 系列与客户规范分别建立不同结构和验证框架，每个项目都应明确准确类型与版本。

text.zh: 按模块负载、布线路径和接头导体范围选择线材。
text.en: Select wire for module load, routing and connector conductor range.

text.zh: 线材外径须匹配端子绝缘支撑、线封和分支保护。
text.en: Match wire diameter to terminal insulation support, seals and branch protection.

text.zh: 先提供热源、油液和固定方式，再审核材料选项。
text.en: Define heat sources, fluids and fixing methods before reviewing material options.

text.zh: 车载灯具引线可按项目需求评审。导体材质、截面与绞合按负载及端子适配选择。
text.en: For vehicle lamp leads, review the project conditions. Select conductor material, area and stranding for load and terminal suitability.

text.zh: 车身控制器配线可按项目需求评审。绝缘材料、壁厚和外径分别记录，供线封与工具审核。
text.en: For body-controller wiring, review the project conditions. Record insulation material, wall thickness and diameter separately for seal and tool review.

text.zh: 车辆检修尾线可按项目需求评审。温度、油液暴露和安装条件需要明确使用边界。
text.en: For vehicle service pigtails, review the project conditions. Define the operating boundary for temperature, fluid exposure and installation.

text.zh: 汽车线材规范、型号和供货料号按项目文件确定。 GXL、TXL等名称需有对应规格证据。
text.en: Define automotive wire specification, model and supply part number from project documents. Names such as GXL/TXL need matching specification evidence.

text.zh: 导体材质、截面与绞合按负载及端子适配选择。 薄壁外观不能确定温度或标准。
text.en: Select conductor material, area and stranding for load and terminal suitability. Thin-wall appearance does not establish temperature or standard.

text.zh: 绝缘材料、壁厚和外径分别记录，供线封与工具审核。 端子和线封需匹配真实导体及外径。
text.en: Record insulation material, wall thickness and diameter separately for seal and tool review. Match terminals/seals to the actual conductor and outer diameter.

question.en: Does a GXL or TXL name fully define the supplied wire?

answer.en: Names such as GXL/TXL need matching specification evidence. Define automotive wire specification, model and supply part number from project documents.

question.zh: 薄壁外观可以确定温度等级吗？

answer.zh: 薄壁外观不能确定温度或标准。导体材质、截面与绞合按负载及端子适配选择。
answer.en: Thin-wall appearance does not establish temperature or standard. Select conductor material, area and stranding for load and terminal suitability.

question.zh: 更换线材为什么要重新核对线封？
question.en: Why must seals be reviewed when the wire changes?

answer.zh: 端子和线封需匹配真实导体及外径。绝缘材料、壁厚和外径分别记录，供线封与工具审核。
answer.en: Match terminals/seals to the actual conductor and outer diameter. Record insulation material, wall thickness and diameter separately for seal and tool review.

introVariants.en: Internal wiring, AWM, flexible cord and the completed appliance have different specification and approval boundaries. The exact construction and use conditions must be identified.
introVariants.zh: 内部配线、AWM、柔性软线与完整电器具有不同规范和批准边界，必须明确准确结构与使用条件。

text.zh: 按设备布线要求核对线材式样、导体与绝缘尺寸。
text.en: Review wire style, conductors and insulation dimensions against appliance wiring requirements.

text.zh: 分别定义信号回路、端子范围和靠近热源的位置。
text.en: Define signal circuits, terminal range and positions near heat sources separately.

text.zh: 记录额定依据、端接方式和印字要求，方便物料追溯。
text.en: Record rating basis, termination method and marking requirements for material traceability.

text.zh: 电器继电器端可按项目需求评审。导体线规、绞合和镀层须匹配端接工艺。
text.en: For appliance relay ends, review the project conditions. Match conductor gauge, stranding and plating to the termination process.

text.zh: 加热器辅助配线可按项目需求评审。电压、温度与绝缘层结构对应准确线材型号。
text.en: For heater auxiliary wiring, review the project conditions. Tie voltage, temperature and insulation construction to the exact wire model.

text.zh: 电器显示控制模块可按项目需求评审。阻燃方法、印字和追溯信息列入材料验收要求。
text.en: For appliance display-control modules, review the project conditions. Include flame-test method, marking and traceability in material acceptance.

text.zh: 按指定AWM式样或其他线材标准核对有效文件。 AWM认可不等于电器整机批准。

text.zh: 导体线规、绞合和镀层须匹配端接工艺。 相同式样可能有不同线径和外径。

introVariants.zh: MTW、AWM 与现场敷设电线具有不同产品和安装范围，必须审核准确印字、位置与适用标准。

text.zh: 定义固定布线路径、端接位置和可维护的连接余量。

text.zh: 接地功能、颜色及安装点依据具体设备规范确认。

text.zh: 控制柜门配线可按项目需求评审。按端接方式选择截面、导体柔性和颜色。
text.en: For control-cabinet door wiring, review the project conditions. Select area, conductor flexibility and colour for the termination method.

text.zh: 继电器模块接线可按项目需求评审。电压、温度和绝缘外径各自形成材料字段。

value.zh: 请提供目标市场、机器标准、回路表、路径图、准确线材型号、端接系统与验证方案。

question.zh: 固定设备线能用于持续运动吗？
question.en: Can fixed equipment wire be used for continuous motion?

answer.zh: 固定设备线与持续运动线分开选型。明确设备布线规范、线材型号与固定安装方式。
answer.en: Select fixed-equipment wire separately from continuous-motion wire. Define equipment wiring specification, wire model and fixed installation method.

question.zh: 截面相同为什么还要记录绝缘外径？
question.en: Why record insulation diameter when conductor area matches?

answer.zh: 导体截面与绝缘外径分别记录。按端接方式选择截面、导体柔性和颜色。
answer.en: Record conductor area separately from insulation diameter. Select area, conductor flexibility and colour for the termination method.

question.zh: 接地导体颜色可以任意选择吗？
question.en: Can grounding-conductor colours be selected freely?

answer.zh: 设备接地和导线颜色需按项目规范。电压、温度和绝缘外径各自形成材料字段。
answer.en: Follow project rules for equipment grounding and wire colors. Record voltage, temperature and insulation diameter as separate material fields.

introVariants.en: CAN bus cable assemblies preserve a defined differential path between network nodes, connectors and transceivers.
introVariants.zh: CAN 总线电缆组件在网络节点、连接器与收发器之间保持规定的差分路径。

introVariants.en: The exact CAN profile, physical layer, topology, termination, pair construction and validation scope must be identified together.
introVariants.zh: 准确 CAN 配置、物理层、拓扑、终端、线对结构与验证范围必须共同识别。

text.zh: 按控制器接口、支路长度与终端配置审核电缆结构。
text.en: Review cable construction against controller interfaces, branch lengths and termination arrangement.

text.zh: 目标速率、主干与支路关系应先形成网络图。
text.en: Document target bit rate and trunk-to-branch relationships in a network diagram first.

text.zh: 临时接线也需保留线对关系、接地和终端边界。
text.en: Temporary connections still need defined pair relationships, grounding and termination boundaries.

text.zh: 控制器总线转接可按项目需求评审。阻抗目标、绞距与导体规格按选定电缆文件确认。
text.en: For controller bus adapters, review the project conditions. Confirm impedance target, twist pitch and conductors from the selected cable documents.

text.zh: 现场节点引线可按项目需求评审。分别注明主干、支路长度和终端电阻位置。
text.en: For field-node leads, review the project conditions. Specify trunk length, branch lengths and termination-resistor locations separately.

text.zh: 设备检修总线端可按项目需求评审。屏蔽、接地和环境要求按完整设备网络审核。
text.en: For equipment service-bus ends, review the project conditions. Review shielding, grounding and environment for the complete equipment network.

text.zh: 明确CAN物理层、目标速率与网络拓扑。 120欧常见目标不能直接填成示例实测值。
text.en: Define the CAN physical layer, target bit rate and network topology. A common 120-ohm target is not an example's measured value.

text.zh: 阻抗目标、绞距与导体规格按选定电缆文件确认。 终端电阻属于网络设计不是所有线缆自带。
text.en: Confirm impedance target, twist pitch and conductors from the selected cable documents. Termination belongs to network design and is not built into every cable.

text.zh: 分别注明主干、支路长度和终端电阻位置。 速率与距离需结合完整拓扑验证。
text.en: Specify trunk length, branch lengths and termination-resistor locations separately. Validate rate/distance with the complete topology.

label.zh: 样品与放行依据
label.en: Sample and release basis

value.en: Release records the cable, pair and shield construction, connectors, pinout, topology, termination, lengths, process, traceability and agreed evidence.
value.zh: 放行记录包含线缆、线对与屏蔽结构、接口、针脚、拓扑、终端、长度、工艺、追溯与约定证据。

question.zh: 常见120欧目标可直接当作实测值吗？
question.en: Can the common 120-ohm target be treated as a measured value?

answer.zh: 120欧常见目标不能直接填成示例实测值。明确CAN物理层、目标速率与网络拓扑。
answer.en: A common 120-ohm target is not an example's measured value. Define the CAN physical layer, target bit rate and network topology.

question.zh: CAN电缆都自带终端电阻吗？
question.en: Does every CAN cable include termination resistors?

answer.zh: 终端电阻属于网络设计不是所有线缆自带。阻抗目标、绞距与导体规格按选定电缆文件确认。
answer.en: Termination belongs to network design and is not built into every cable. Confirm impedance target, twist pitch and conductors from the selected cable documents.

question.zh: 速率和距离可以脱离拓扑确定吗？
question.en: Can bit rate and distance be defined independently of topology?

answer.zh: 速率与距离需结合完整拓扑验证。分别注明主干、支路长度和终端电阻位置。
answer.en: Validate rate/distance with the complete topology. Specify trunk length, branch lengths and termination-resistor locations separately.

introVariants.en: Coaxial cable assemblies preserve controlled impedance through the cable, connector and every transition.
introVariants.zh: 同轴电缆组件在电缆、连接器与每一处过渡中维持受控阻抗。

introVariants.en: System impedance, frequency, loss, power, cable construction, connector interface, termination and validation must be defined together.
introVariants.zh: 系统阻抗、频率、损耗、功率、线缆结构、连接器界面、端接与验证必须共同定义。

text.zh: 明确频段、阻抗与长度，再审核连接器和端接损耗。
text.en: Define frequency band, impedance and length before reviewing connectors and termination loss.

text.zh: 按走线、外径和弯曲条件选择同轴结构与尾部保护。
text.en: Select coaxial construction and rear protection for routing, diameter and bending conditions.

text.zh: 测量边界需区分原电缆数据与完整端接组件表现。
text.en: Distinguish raw-cable data from finished-assembly performance at the measurement boundary.

text.zh: 天线馈线位置可按项目需求评审。分别规定阻抗、频率范围及所需衰减数据。
text.en: For antenna feed positions, review the project conditions. Specify impedance, frequency range and required attenuation data separately.

text.zh: 射频面板转接可按项目需求评审。记录编织、箔层、覆盖结构与护套材料。
text.en: For rf panel adapters, review the project conditions. Record braid, foil, coverage construction and jacket material.

text.zh: 仪器测量端口可按项目需求评审。外径、最小弯曲条件与端接加工尺寸成套匹配。
text.en: For instrument measurement ports, review the project conditions. Match diameter, minimum bending conditions and termination dimensions together.

text.zh: 准确型号须对应中心导体、介质和厂家数据表。 RG标称必须对应准确厂家规格。
text.en: Tie the exact cable model to centre conductor, dielectric and supplier data. RG labels must match the exact manufacturer's specification.

text.zh: 分别规定阻抗、频率范围及所需衰减数据。 50欧与75欧不能以颜色或粗细识别。
text.en: Specify impedance, frequency range and required attenuation data separately. Do not identify 50/75 ohms by color or diameter.

text.zh: 记录编织、箔层、覆盖结构与护套材料。 原缆衰减与完整端接组件损耗分开记录。
text.en: Record braid, foil, coverage construction and jacket material. Record raw-cable attenuation separately from terminated-assembly loss.

label.en: Coax type, center conductor and dielectric

value.en: Tie the exact cable model to centre conductor, dielectric and supplier data.

value.en: Record braid, foil, coverage construction and jacket material.

label.en: Diameter, bend radius and termination dimensions

value.zh: 外径、最小弯曲条件与端接加工尺寸成套匹配。
value.en: Match diameter, minimum bending conditions and termination dimensions together.

label.en: Installation and operating boundary

value.en: Provide equipment ports, impedance, frequency band, signal or power, length, cable limits, route, environment and test evidence.
value.zh: 请提供设备端口、阻抗、频段、信号或功率、长度、线缆限制、路径、环境与测试证据。

label.zh: 样品与放行依据
label.en: Sample and release basis

value.en: Release records cable and connector part numbers, impedance, length, strip and termination controls, labels, environment and agreed electrical evidence.
value.zh: 放行记录包含线缆与连接器料号、阻抗、长度、剥线和端接控制、标签、环境及约定电气证据。

question.zh: RG名称能代替准确线缆规格吗？
question.en: Can an RG name replace the exact cable specification?

answer.zh: RG标称必须对应准确厂家规格。准确型号须对应中心导体、介质和厂家数据表。
answer.en: RG labels must match the exact manufacturer's specification. Tie the exact cable model to centre conductor, dielectric and supplier data.

question.zh: 粗细和颜色能区分50欧与75欧吗？
question.en: Can size and colour distinguish 50-ohm and 75-ohm cables?

answer.zh: 50欧与75欧不能以颜色或粗细识别。分别规定阻抗、频率范围及所需衰减数据。
answer.en: Do not identify 50/75 ohms by color or diameter. Specify impedance, frequency range and required attenuation data separately.

question.zh: 原缆衰减等于成品组件损耗吗？
question.en: Is raw-cable attenuation equal to finished-assembly loss?

answer.zh: 原缆衰减与完整端接组件损耗分开记录。记录编织、箔层、覆盖结构与护套材料。
answer.en: Record raw-cable attenuation separately from terminated-assembly loss. Record braid, foil, coverage construction and jacket material.

avoidMisidentification.en: RG labels must match the exact manufacturer's specification

avoidMisidentification.en: Do not identify 50/75 ohms by color or diameter

introVariants.en: Drag-chain cable is engineered around the complete repeated-motion profile.
introVariants.zh: 拖链电缆围绕完整重复运动谱进行设计。

introVariants.en: Travel, bend radius, speed, acceleration, carrier layout, construction and environment define service life together.
introVariants.zh: 行程、弯曲半径、速度、加速度、拖链布置、结构与环境共同定义寿命。

text.zh: 按行程、速度和加速度定义电缆的动态使用条件。
text.en: Define dynamic cable duty through travel, speed and acceleration.

text.zh: 核对电缆占用空间、分隔方式和两端固定位置。
text.en: Check cable space, separators and fixing positions at both ends.

text.zh: 弯曲半径、信号结构和端接保护共同决定选型。
text.en: Bend radius, signal construction and termination protection guide selection together.

text.zh: 移动控制单元配线可按项目需求评审。提供拖链半径、行程、速度、加速度和安装姿态。
text.en: For moving control-unit wiring, review the project conditions. Provide carrier radius, travel, speed, acceleration and installation orientation.

text.zh: 拖链内信号线对可按项目需求评审。循环目标须带温度、半径及动作试验条件。
text.en: For signal pairs inside cable carriers, review the project conditions. State cycle targets with temperature, radius and motion test conditions.

text.zh: 运动电缆端接位置可按项目需求评审。定义拖链分隔、填充与两端固定和应力消除。
text.en: For moving-cable termination positions, review the project conditions. Define carrier separators, filling, end fixing and strain relief.

text.zh: 使用明确标注动态用途的准确电缆型号。 固定安装伺服线不能当拖链线。
text.en: Use an exact cable model with documented dynamic-duty scope. Fixed-installation servo cable is not drag-chain cable.

text.zh: 提供拖链半径、行程、速度、加速度和安装姿态。 循环数字需对应半径、速度和试验条件。
text.en: Provide carrier radius, travel, speed, acceleration and installation orientation. Cycle figures must identify radius, speed and test conditions.

text.zh: 循环目标须带温度、半径及动作试验条件。 拖链弯折额定不自动包含扭转。
text.en: State cycle targets with temperature, radius and motion test conditions. Drag-chain flex ratings do not automatically include torsion.

value.en: State cycle targets with temperature, radius and motion test conditions.

value.en: Define carrier separators, filling, end fixing and strain relief.

label.en: Installation and operating boundary

value.en: Provide motion, circuits, carrier, endpoints, environment and cycle target.
value.zh: 请提供运动、回路、拖链、端点、环境与循环目标。

label.zh: 样品与放行依据
label.en: Sample and release basis

value.en: Release records the complete moving cable system and agreed cycle evidence.
value.zh: 放行记录包含完整运动线缆系统与约定循环证据。

question.zh: 固定安装伺服线等同于拖链线吗？
question.en: Is fixed-installation servo cable equivalent to carrier cable?

answer.zh: 固定安装伺服线不能当拖链线。使用明确标注动态用途的准确电缆型号。
answer.en: Fixed-installation servo cable is not drag-chain cable. Use an exact cable model with documented dynamic-duty scope.

question.zh: 循环数字可以脱离试验条件比较吗？
question.en: Can cycle counts be compared without test conditions?

answer.zh: 循环数字需对应半径、速度和试验条件。提供拖链半径、行程、速度、加速度和安装姿态。
answer.en: Cycle figures must identify radius, speed and test conditions. Provide carrier radius, travel, speed, acceleration and installation orientation.

question.zh: 拖链弯折额定包含机器人扭转吗？
question.en: Does a carrier bending rating include robot torsion?

answer.zh: 拖链弯折额定不自动包含扭转。循环目标须带温度、半径及动作试验条件。
answer.en: Drag-chain flex ratings do not automatically include torsion. State cycle targets with temperature, radius and motion test conditions.

introVariants.en: Flame-retardant cable limits flame propagation under a defined test arrangement.
introVariants.zh: 阻燃电线电缆在规定试验排列下限制火焰蔓延。

introVariants.en: Single-cable, bunched-cable, fire-resistance, smoke and halogen tests answer different questions.
introVariants.zh: 单根、成束、耐火、烟密度与无卤试验回答不同问题。

text.zh: 按项目指定试验方法审核线材结构和报告范围。
text.en: Review cable construction and report scope against the project-specified test method.

text.zh: 阻燃、温度和电气要求分别落实到准确型号。
text.en: Tie flame, temperature and electrical requirements separately to the exact model.

text.zh: 需要成束试验时，试样与安装方式必须明确。
text.en: Where bunched-cable tests are required, define the specimen and installation method.

text.zh: 电源柜内部配线可按项目需求评审。明确单根或成束试验，避免混用适用范围。
text.en: For internal power-cabinet wiring, review the project conditions. Define single-cable or bunched testing to avoid mixing their scopes.

text.zh: 设备材料替换项目可按项目需求评审。绝缘、护套与试样规格对应实际供货结构。
text.en: For equipment material substitutions, review the project conditions. Match insulation, jacket and test specimen to the supplied construction.

text.zh: 线槽内成束配线可按项目需求评审。报告需可对应准确型号、结构和供应批次。
text.en: For bunched wiring inside cable ducts, review the project conditions. Reports must map to the exact model, construction and supply batch.

text.zh: 指定阻燃标准、试验方法及要求等级。 阻燃不等于耐火保持通电。
text.en: Specify the flame standard, test method and required classification. Flame retardance is not fire-resistant circuit integrity.

text.zh: 明确单根或成束试验，避免混用适用范围。 阻燃不等于无卤或低烟。
text.en: Define single-cable or bunched testing to avoid mixing their scopes. Flame retardance is not halogen-free or low-smoke performance.

text.zh: 绝缘、护套与试样规格对应实际供货结构。 不同试验体系等级不得直接等同。
text.en: Match insulation, jacket and test specimen to the supplied construction. Do not equate classifications from different test systems.

answer.en: Flame retardance is not fire-resistant circuit integrity. Specify the flame standard, test method and required classification.

question.zh: 阻燃是否同时代表无卤和低烟？
question.en: Does flame retardance also mean halogen-free and low-smoke?

answer.zh: 阻燃不等于无卤或低烟。明确单根或成束试验，避免混用适用范围。
answer.en: Flame retardance is not halogen-free or low-smoke performance. Define single-cable or bunched testing to avoid mixing their scopes.

question.zh: 不同阻燃体系的等级能直接等同吗？
question.en: Can classifications from different flame-test systems be treated as equivalent?

text.zh: 导体截面、安装散热和持续负载共同决定材料选择。
text.en: Select materials for conductor area, installed heat dissipation and continuous load together.

text.zh: 走线路径、绝缘间距和护套防护应匹配安装条件。
text.en: Match routing, insulation clearance and jacket protection to installation conditions.

text.zh: 电源柜进出线可按项目需求评审。导体截面按负载、温升和安装降额审核。
text.en: For power-cabinet cable entry and exit, review the project conditions. Review conductor area for load, temperature rise and installation derating.

text.en: For battery-equipment project interfaces, review the project conditions. Define the material and dimensions of insulation, shield and jacket layers.

text.zh: 大截面端子连接可按项目需求评审。约定耐压、局放或其他项目要求的试验边界。

question.zh: 粗直径能证明电缆高压额定吗？
question.en: Does a large diameter establish a high-voltage rating?

answer.zh: 粗直径不能证明高压额定。分别记录工作电压、瞬态峰值与适用规范。
answer.en: Large diameter does not establish high-voltage rating. Record operating voltage, transient peaks and applicable specifications separately.

question.zh: 测试电压就是持续工作电压吗？
question.en: Is test voltage the same as continuous operating voltage?

answer.zh: 测试电压与工作电压分开记录。导体截面按负载、温升和安装降额审核。
answer.en: Record test voltage separately from working voltage. Review conductor area for load, temperature rise and installation derating.

introVariants.en: Shielded twisted pair preserves balanced geometry and a controlled shield path.

text.zh: 围绕目标信号的阻抗、电容和线对关系定义结构。
text.en: Define construction around the impedance, capacitance and pair relationships of the target signal.

text.zh: 根据干扰源和设备接地方案选择总屏蔽或分对屏蔽。
text.en: Choose overall or pair shielding for interference sources and equipment grounding.

text.zh: 端接区的解绞长度和屏蔽接续需纳入装配要求。
text.en: Include untwist length and shield continuity at terminations in assembly requirements.

text.zh: 精密传感器线对可按项目需求评审。选择总屏蔽、分对屏蔽或组合结构。
text.en: For precision-sensor pairs, review the project conditions. Select overall, individual-pair or combined shielding.

text.zh: 控制柜模拟信号端可按项目需求评审。阻抗和电容目标需对应准确电缆及目标信号。
text.en: For cabinet analogue-signal ends, review the project conditions. Tie impedance and capacitance targets to the exact cable and intended signal.

text.zh: 屏蔽面板连接位置可按项目需求评审。按系统设计确定排流线、接地位置和端接方式。
text.en: For shielded panel connection positions, review the project conditions. Define drain wires, grounding points and termination method through the system design.

text.zh: 记录线对数量、导体规格与绞距依据。 双绞结构不能证明某通信协议。
text.en: Record pair count, conductor specification and twist-pitch basis. Twisted-pair construction does not establish a communication protocol.

text.zh: 选择总屏蔽、分对屏蔽或组合结构。 屏蔽覆盖率需材料规格或测量依据。
text.en: Select overall, individual-pair or combined shielding. Shield coverage needs a material specification or measurement.

answer.en: Twisted-pair construction does not establish a communication protocol. Record pair count, conductor specification and twist-pitch basis.

question.en: Can shield coverage be entered from a photograph?

answer.zh: 屏蔽覆盖率需材料规格或测量依据。选择总屏蔽、分对屏蔽或组合结构。
answer.en: Shield coverage needs a material specification or measurement. Select overall, individual-pair or combined shielding.

answer.en: Control pair untwist length at terminations. Tie impedance and capacitance targets to the exact cable and intended signal.

question.zh: 船用名称是否等于船级社认可？
question.en: Does a marine designation establish classification approval?

answer.zh: 船用名称不等于船级社认可。定义船舶用途、安装区域及需要的船级文件范围。
answer.en: A marine label does not establish classification-society approval. Define vessel use, installation area and any required classification-document scope.

question.zh: 舱内、甲板与浸水条件可合并吗？
question.en: Can interior, deck and immersion conditions be combined?

answer.zh: 舱内、甲板与长期浸水分别定义。分别说明盐、湿热、油液与温度暴露条件。
answer.en: Define interior, deck and continuous immersion uses separately. Specify salt, humidity, fluids and temperature exposure separately.

question.zh: 船用电缆文件能证明端接密封吗？
question.en: Do marine cable documents establish termination sealing?

answer.zh: 连接器与端接密封需另行验证。导体、护套、屏蔽及阻燃结构按项目组合选择。
answer.en: Validate connector and termination sealing separately. Select conductor, jacket, shield and flame construction for the project.

avoidMisidentification.en: Validate connector and termination sealing separately

introVariants.en: Medical project cables are engineered as components within the equipment safety and performance system.
introVariants.zh: 医疗项目电缆作为设备安全与性能体系内的元件进行设计。

introVariants.en: Equipment risk control, applied parts, signals, cleaning, usability and traceability define the cable.
introVariants.zh: 设备风险控制、应用部分、信号、清洁、可用性与追溯共同定义线缆。

text.zh: 先区分内部布线与接触边界，再确定材料及绝缘要求。
text.en: Distinguish internal wiring from contact boundaries before defining materials and insulation.

text.zh: 明确擦拭介质、频率与温度，审核护套和标识材料。
text.en: Define wipe agents, frequency and temperature before reviewing jacket and label materials.

text.zh: 设备设计方确定接触方式和文件范围，配线据此选材。
text.en: The equipment designer defines contact conditions and document scope, which guide cable selection.

text.zh: 仪器可拆连接端可按项目需求评审。接触时间、清洁和消毒介质须由设备要求确定。
text.en: For detachable instrument connections, review the project conditions. Define contact duration, cleaning and disinfection agents from equipment requirements.

text.zh: 设备模块内部引线可按项目需求评审。材料牌号、柔性与电气隔离分别形成选材条件。
text.en: For internal equipment-module leads, review the project conditions. Specify material grade, flexibility and electrical isolation separately.

text.zh: 需要清洁的外部引线可按项目需求评审。生物相容或设备文件需对应明确组件与接触范围。
text.en: For external leads requiring cleaning, review the project conditions. Biocompatibility or equipment documents must identify the component and contact scope.

text.zh: 说明设备内部、外部或患者接触的实际用途。 材料医用标签不能证明成品组件合规。
text.en: Define actual internal, external or patient-contact use. A medical-material label does not establish finished-assembly compliance.

text.zh: 接触时间、清洁和消毒介质须由设备要求确定。 灭菌、消毒和擦拭条件分别确认。
text.en: Define contact duration, cleaning and disinfection agents from equipment requirements. Confirm sterilization, disinfection and wipe conditions separately.

text.zh: 材料牌号、柔性与电气隔离分别形成选材条件。 患者接触边界需由设备设计方确定。
text.en: Specify material grade, flexibility and electrical isolation separately. The device designer must define patient-contact boundaries.

question.zh: 医用材料标签能证明成品合规吗？
question.en: Does a medical-material label establish finished-assembly compliance?

answer.zh: 材料医用标签不能证明成品组件合规。说明设备内部、外部或患者接触的实际用途。
answer.en: A medical-material label does not establish finished-assembly compliance. Define actual internal, external or patient-contact use.

question.zh: 灭菌、消毒和擦拭可以作为同一条件吗？
question.en: Are sterilization, disinfection and wiping the same condition?

answer.zh: 灭菌、消毒和擦拭条件分别确认。接触时间、清洁和消毒介质须由设备要求确定。
answer.en: Confirm sterilization, disinfection and wipe conditions separately. Define contact duration, cleaning and disinfection agents from equipment requirements.

question.zh: 谁确定患者接触边界？
question.en: Who defines the patient-contact boundary?

answer.zh: 患者接触边界需由设备设计方确定。材料牌号、柔性与电气隔离分别形成选材条件。
answer.en: The device designer must define patient-contact boundaries. Specify material grade, flexibility and electrical isolation separately.

introVariants.en: Measurement cables preserve low-level, precision and high-bandwidth signals between sensors and instruments.
introVariants.zh: 测量仪器电缆在传感器与仪器之间保持低电平、精密与高带宽信号。

introVariants.en: Resistance, capacitance, leakage, noise, impedance and motion can all change the measurement.
introVariants.zh: 电阻、电容、泄漏、噪声、阻抗与运动都可能改变测量结果。

text.zh: 先定义信号、量程和允许噪声，再选择导体与屏蔽。
text.en: Define signal, range and permitted noise before selecting conductors and shielding.

text.zh: 将线长、电容、漏电和接地纳入完整测量路径。
text.en: Include length, capacitance, leakage and grounding in the measurement path.

text.zh: 若使用热电偶或补偿导线，材料体系与极性需单列。
text.en: Where thermocouple or compensation wire is required, specify the material system and polarity separately.

text.zh: 测量探头连接可按项目需求评审。线对、屏蔽、电容与漏电要求按仪器输入定义。
text.en: For measurement probe connections, review the project conditions. Define pairs, shielding, capacitance and leakage for the instrument input.

text.zh: 数据采集输入端可按项目需求评审。特殊导体或补偿导线须用准确材料文件确认。
text.en: For data-acquisition input ends, review the project conditions. Confirm special conductors or compensation wire with exact material documents.

text.zh: 校准台架引线可按项目需求评审。固定或运动条件、端接和参考接地共同审核。
text.en: For calibration-bench leads, review the project conditions. Review fixed or moving duty, termination and reference grounding together.

text.zh: 记录测量信号、量程、带宽及噪声目标。 普通铜线不能替代指定补偿导线。
text.en: Record measurement signal, range, bandwidth and noise targets. Ordinary copper wire cannot replace specified compensating cable.

text.zh: 线对、屏蔽、电容与漏电要求按仪器输入定义。 电缆低噪声名称需有测量条件。
text.en: Define pairs, shielding, capacitance and leakage for the instrument input. A low-noise label needs measurement conditions.

text.zh: 特殊导体或补偿导线须用准确材料文件确认。 屏蔽与仪器参考地不得随意并接。
text.en: Confirm special conductors or compensation wire with exact material documents. Do not arbitrarily connect shields to instrument reference ground.

value.en: Record measurement signal, range, bandwidth and noise targets.

value.en: Confirm special conductors or compensation wire with exact material documents.

label.en: Fixed/moving use, termination and grounding

value.zh: 固定或运动条件、端接和参考接地共同审核。
value.en: Review fixed or moving duty, termination and reference grounding together.

label.en: Installation and operating boundary

value.en: Provide sensor, range, bandwidth, accuracy, route, connectors and calibration boundary.
value.zh: 请提供传感器、量程、带宽、精度、路径、接口与校准边界。

label.en: Sample and release basis

value.en: Release records the configured measurement lead and agreed evidence.
value.zh: 放行记录包含实际配置测量引线与约定证据。

question.zh: 普通铜线可以替代补偿导线吗？
question.en: Can ordinary copper wire replace compensation wire?

answer.zh: 普通铜线不能替代指定补偿导线。记录测量信号、量程、带宽及噪声目标。
answer.en: Ordinary copper wire cannot replace specified compensating cable. Record measurement signal, range, bandwidth and noise targets.

question.zh: 低噪声名称能直接作为测量结果吗？
question.en: Can a low-noise designation be treated as a measurement result?

answer.zh: 电缆低噪声名称需有测量条件。线对、屏蔽、电容与漏电要求按仪器输入定义。
answer.en: A low-noise label needs measurement conditions. Define pairs, shielding, capacitance and leakage for the instrument input.

question.zh: 屏蔽可以任意接到仪器参考地吗？
question.en: Can a shield be connected freely to the instrument reference ground?

answer.zh: 屏蔽与仪器参考地不得随意并接。特殊导体或补偿导线须用准确材料文件确认。
answer.en: Do not arbitrarily connect shields to instrument reference ground. Confirm special conductors or compensation wire with exact material documents.

introVariants.en: Outdoor cable construction is selected around sunlight, water, temperature, route and installation.
introVariants.zh: 户外电缆结构围绕日照、水、温度、路径与安装方式选择。

introVariants.en: A black jacket alone does not prove outdoor suitability; cable, interfaces and supports form one exposed system.
introVariants.zh: 黑色护套不能单独证明户外适用性，线缆、接口与支撑构成完整暴露系统。

text.zh: 按日照、温度和安装固定条件选择护套与防护。
text.en: Select jacket and protection for sunlight, temperature and fixing conditions.

text.zh: 连接口、端头进水和线缆走向需要一起审核。
text.en: Review connection interfaces, end-entry water paths and cable routing together.

text.zh: 明确穿管、暴露或埋地方式，避免把不同用途合并。
text.en: Define conduit, exposed or buried installation rather than combining different duties.

text.zh: 环境传感设备端可按项目需求评审。分别注明雨水、积水、穿管、埋地或直埋用途。
text.en: For environmental-sensor equipment ends, review the project conditions. State rain, pooling water, conduit, burial or direct-burial duty separately.

text.zh: 室外控制箱进线可按项目需求评审。护套材料与耐候数据须对应准确供货型号。
text.en: For outdoor control-box cable entries, review the project conditions. Tie jacket material and weathering data to the exact supplied model.

text.zh: 暴露安装固定段可按项目需求评审。记录安装拉力、磨损点及两端密封结构。
text.en: For exposed installation runs, review the project conditions. Record installation tension, abrasion points and sealing at both ends.

text.zh: 提供温度范围、日照与紫外线暴露条件。 户外适用不能自动转为直埋或浸水。
text.en: Provide temperature range, sunlight and ultraviolet exposure conditions. Outdoor suitability does not establish burial or immersion suitability.

text.zh: 分别注明雨水、积水、穿管、埋地或直埋用途。 耐候声明需对应具体试验与材料。
text.en: State rain, pooling water, conduit, burial or direct-burial duty separately. Weathering claims must identify tests and materials.

text.zh: 护套材料与耐候数据须对应准确供货型号。 端头进水会影响完整电缆系统。
text.en: Tie jacket material and weathering data to the exact supplied model. End ingress affects the complete cable system.

question.zh: 户外适用是否包含直埋和长期浸水？
question.en: Does outdoor suitability include direct burial and long-term immersion?

answer.zh: 户外适用不能自动转为直埋或浸水。提供温度范围、日照与紫外线暴露条件。
answer.en: Outdoor suitability does not establish burial or immersion suitability. Provide temperature range, sunlight and ultraviolet exposure conditions.

question.zh: 耐候声明需要对应什么文件？
question.en: What documents must a weathering claim identify?

answer.zh: 耐候声明需对应具体试验与材料。分别注明雨水、积水、穿管、埋地或直埋用途。
answer.en: Weathering claims must identify tests and materials. State rain, pooling water, conduit, burial or direct-burial duty separately.

question.zh: 端头进水为什么需要单独防护？
question.en: Why is water entry at cable ends a separate concern?

answer.zh: 端头进水会影响完整电缆系统。护套材料与耐候数据须对应准确供货型号。
answer.en: End ingress affects the complete cable system. Tie jacket material and weathering data to the exact supplied model.

introVariants.en: Cross-linked insulation must be specified as part of a complete cable and installation system.
introVariants.zh: 交联绝缘必须作为完整线缆与安装系统的一部分进行规定。

introVariants.en: XLPE is a material family, not a universal voltage, temperature, fire or outdoor rating.
introVariants.zh: XLPE 是材料家族，不是通用的电压、温度、阻燃或户外等级。

text.zh: 按电压、热条件和端接需要比较实际交联材料。
text.en: Compare actual cross-linked materials for voltage, thermal duty and termination needs.

text.zh: 导体、绝缘和护套分别选型，不以材料名称替代规格。
text.en: Select conductor, insulation and jacket separately rather than substituting a material name for a specification.

text.zh: 热老化依据、弯曲空间和端子温度边界共同审核。
text.en: Review thermal-aging evidence, bend clearance and contact temperature limits together.

text.zh: 电气设备柜内段可按项目需求评审。导体截面、绝缘厚度与外径分别列入材料定义。
text.en: For internal electrical-equipment runs, review the project conditions. Record conductor area, insulation thickness and diameter separately.

text.zh: 车辆电源项目配线可按项目需求评审。按实际型号核对温度、电压及热老化依据。
text.en: For vehicle power-project wiring, review the project conditions. Check temperature, voltage and thermal-aging evidence for the actual model.

text.zh: 设备端子连接段可按项目需求评审。端接、剥皮和弯曲条件应适合所选绝缘结构。
text.en: For equipment terminal-connection runs, review the project conditions. Match termination, stripping and bending conditions to the selected insulation.

text.zh: 确认交联材料类型、工艺及准确来源规格。 交联不等于任何固定温度等级。
text.en: Confirm cross-linked material type, process and exact supply specification. Cross-linking does not establish one fixed temperature class.

text.zh: 导体截面、绝缘厚度与外径分别列入材料定义。 交联绝缘与护套材料分别记录。
text.en: Record conductor area, insulation thickness and diameter separately. Record cross-linked insulation separately from jacket material.

text.zh: 按实际型号核对温度、电压及热老化依据。 耐热与阻燃性能需要各自依据。
text.en: Check temperature, voltage and thermal-aging evidence for the actual model. Heat and flame properties need separate evidence.

question.zh: 交联材料都有相同温度等级吗？
question.en: Do all cross-linked materials have the same temperature rating?

answer.zh: 交联不等于任何固定温度等级。确认交联材料类型、工艺及准确来源规格。
answer.en: Cross-linking does not establish one fixed temperature class. Confirm cross-linked material type, process and exact supply specification.

question.zh: 交联绝缘是否说明护套也交联？
question.en: Does cross-linked insulation mean the jacket is also cross-linked?

answer.zh: 交联绝缘与护套材料分别记录。导体截面、绝缘厚度与外径分别列入材料定义。
answer.en: Record cross-linked insulation separately from jacket material. Record conductor area, insulation thickness and diameter separately.

question.zh: 耐热证据能代替阻燃证据吗？
question.en: Can heat-resistance evidence replace flame-test evidence?

answer.zh: 耐热与阻燃性能需要各自依据。按实际型号核对温度、电压及热老化依据。
answer.en: Heat and flame properties need separate evidence. Check temperature, voltage and thermal-aging evidence for the actual model.

introVariants.en: A flat profile helps routing only when conductor pitch, pin map and termination are specified together.
introVariants.zh: 扁平结构便于布线，但芯线间距、针脚表与端接方式必须共同定义。

introVariants.en: Round-conductor ribbon cable is not interchangeable with laminated FFC or printed-circuit FPC.
introVariants.zh: 圆导体排线不能与层压式 FFC 或印刷式 FPC 直接互换。

text.zh: 按连接器节距、芯数和红边位置定义排线。
text.en: Define the ribbon around connector pitch, conductor count and marked-edge position.

text.zh: 宽度、厚度和固定折弯位置应配合壳体空间。
text.en: Match width, thickness and fixed fold positions to enclosure clearance.

text.zh: 各端针位视图与端接方向分别记录。
text.en: Record the cavity view and termination direction at each end separately.

text.zh: 多模块排线连接可按项目需求评审。绝缘厚度、总宽度及标识边按准确型号确认。
text.en: For multi-module ribbon connections, review the project conditions. Confirm insulation thickness, total width and marked edge for the exact model.

text.zh: 机柜检修延长线可按项目需求评审。端接形式、连接器与剥线尺寸成套确定。
text.en: For cabinet service-extension leads, review the project conditions. Define termination form, connectors and stripping dimensions together.

text.zh: 固定折返跨板线可按项目需求评审。固定折弯与动态弯折分别规定半径和使用边界。
text.en: For fixed-fold cross-board wiring, review the project conditions. Specify radius and duty separately for fixed folds and dynamic bending.

text.zh: 分别记录导体间距、芯数及每芯截面。 带状散线与FFC结构分开记录。
text.en: Record conductor spacing, count and individual area separately. Record ribbon wire separately from FFC construction.

text.zh: 绝缘厚度、总宽度及标识边按准确型号确认。 红边与1脚关系需按装配图确认。
text.en: Confirm insulation thickness, total width and marked edge for the exact model. Confirm red-edge/pin-1 mapping against the drawing.

text.zh: 端接形式、连接器与剥线尺寸成套确定。 扁平外形不能证明动态耐弯折。
text.en: Define termination form, connectors and stripping dimensions together. Flat shape does not establish dynamic-flex capability.

label.en: Installation and operating boundary

value.en: Provide conductor count, pitch, gauge, connector part numbers, pin-1 view, route and bend duty.
value.zh: 请提供芯数、间距、线规、连接器料号、1 号针视角、路径与弯折工况。

label.en: Sample and release basis

value.en: Release the complete labelled assembly against its approved pin map and first article.
value.zh: 按获认可的针脚表与首件放行完整标识组件。

question.zh: 带状散线与FFC是同一种材料吗？
question.en: Are ribbon conductors and FFC the same material construction?

answer.zh: 带状散线与FFC结构分开记录。分别记录导体间距、芯数及每芯截面。
answer.en: Record ribbon wire separately from FFC construction. Record conductor spacing, count and individual area separately.

question.zh: 红边一定对应1脚吗？
question.en: Does the marked edge always correspond to pin one?

answer.zh: 红边与1脚关系需按装配图确认。绝缘厚度、总宽度及标识边按准确型号确认。
answer.en: Confirm red-edge/pin-1 mapping against the drawing. Confirm insulation thickness, total width and marked edge for the exact model.

question.zh: 扁平外形能证明动态耐弯折吗？
question.en: Does a flat profile establish dynamic bending capability?

answer.zh: 扁平外形不能证明动态耐弯折。端接形式、连接器与剥线尺寸成套确定。
answer.en: Flat shape does not establish dynamic-flex capability. Define termination form, connectors and stripping dimensions together.

introVariants.en: Flexible leads must be specified against their installed motion, not selected by hand feel alone.
introVariants.zh: 柔性引线必须按安装后的运动工况选型，不能只凭手感。

introVariants.en: Fine stranding, core lay, jacket, support and termination jointly govern the moving assembly.
introVariants.zh: 细绞导体、芯线绞合、护套、支撑和端接共同决定活动组件的表现。

text.zh: 关注操作弯曲、护套手感与端接处股线保持。
text.en: Review operating bends, jacket handling and strand retention at terminations.

text.zh: 实际最小弯曲空间与固定方式应先明确。
text.en: Define the actual minimum bending space and fixing method first.

text.zh: 按弯折或扭转的具体动作选择材料并定义循环验证。
text.en: Select materials and define cycle checks for the actual bending or torsional motion.

text.zh: 便携仪器操作引线可按项目需求评审。护套材质、硬度和外径按安装与端接选择。
text.en: For portable-instrument operating leads, review the project conditions. Select jacket material, hardness and diameter for installation and termination.

text.zh: 台架柔性连接段可按项目需求评审。明确弯折或扭转条件及对应循环目标。
text.en: For flexible bench connections, review the project conditions. Define bending or torsional conditions and the corresponding cycle target.

text.zh: 扭转动作项目评审可按项目需求评审。细股保持、端子适配与近端应力保护共同规定。
text.en: For torsional-motion project review, review the project conditions. Specify strand retention, contact fit and near-end strain protection together.

text.zh: 细股结构、线规与来源型号须由材料文件确认。 手感柔软不等于持续运动额定。
text.en: Confirm fine-strand construction, gauge and supply model from material documents. Soft feel does not establish continuous-motion ratings.

text.zh: 护套材质、硬度和外径按安装与端接选择。 弯折、拖链和机器人扭转分开确认。
text.en: Select jacket material, hardness and diameter for installation and termination. Confirm bending, drag-chain and robot torsion duties separately.

text.zh: 明确弯折或扭转条件及对应循环目标。 细股导体需匹配端子和压接工艺。
text.en: Define bending or torsional conditions and the corresponding cycle target. Match fine-strand conductors to terminals and crimp process.
