value.en: Confirm fine-strand construction, gauge and supply model from material documents.

value.en: Select jacket material, hardness and diameter for installation and termination.

label.en: Bending/torsion conditions and target cycles

value.zh: 明确弯折或扭转条件及对应循环目标。
value.en: Define bending or torsional conditions and the corresponding cycle target.

label.en: Strand retention and termination strain protection

value.zh: 细股保持、端子适配与近端应力保护共同规定。
value.en: Specify strand retention, contact fit and near-end strain protection together.

label.zh: 安装与使用边界
label.en: Installation and operating boundary

value.en: Provide bend radius, cycle and torsion duty, connector drawings and environmental exposure.
value.zh: 请提供弯曲半径、循环与扭转工况、接头图纸及环境条件。

label.zh: 样品与放行依据
label.en: Sample and release basis

value.en: Release the cable and its finished interfaces against project-specific first-article and acceptance checks.
value.zh: 按项目特定的首件与验收要求，放行线缆及完整接口。

question.zh: 手感柔软能证明持续运动额定吗？
question.en: Does a soft feel establish continuous-motion capability?

answer.zh: 手感柔软不等于持续运动额定。细股结构、线规与来源型号须由材料文件确认。
answer.en: Soft feel does not establish continuous-motion ratings. Confirm fine-strand construction, gauge and supply model from material documents.

question.zh: 弯折、拖链和扭转是同一工况吗？
question.en: Are bending, carrier motion and torsion the same duty?

answer.zh: 弯折、拖链和机器人扭转分开确认。护套材质、硬度和外径按安装与端接选择。
answer.en: Confirm bending, drag-chain and robot torsion duties separately. Select jacket material, hardness and diameter for installation and termination.

question.zh: 细股导体可以沿用任意压接工艺吗？
question.en: Can fine-strand conductors use any crimp process?

answer.zh: 细股导体需匹配端子和压接工艺。明确弯折或扭转条件及对应循环目标。
answer.en: Match fine-strand conductors to terminals and crimp process. Define bending or torsional conditions and the corresponding cycle target.

introVariants.en: The thermal limit of a finished lead depends on its actual route, load and lowest-rated component.
introVariants.zh: 成品引线的耐热边界取决于真实路径、负载及额定值最低的部件。

introVariants.en: Silicone, FEP, PTFE and glass-braid constructions require exact product data; a material name alone is not a rating.
introVariants.zh: 硅橡胶、FEP、PTFE 与玻纤编织结构都要核对准确型号数据，材料名称不能单独代表额定值。

text.zh: 将持续温度、峰值和热源距离作为独立选型条件。
text.en: Treat continuous temperature, peaks and heat-source distance as separate selection conditions.

text.zh: 线材绝缘之外，端子、套管和固定材料也需核对。
text.en: Check contacts, sleeves and fixing materials as well as wire insulation.

text.zh: 明确材料、信号和端接温度边界，保留安装路径数据。
text.en: Define material, signal and termination temperature limits, with routing data retained.

text.zh: 加热器端子连接可按项目需求评审。分别说明持续、短时及周围环境温度条件。
text.en: For heater terminal connections, review the project conditions. State continuous, short-duration and ambient temperature conditions separately.

text.zh: 热区温度探头线可按项目需求评审。电压、热老化和化学暴露按实际项目审核。
text.en: For temperature-probe leads in hot zones, review the project conditions. Review voltage, thermal aging and chemical exposure for the actual project.

text.zh: 靠近热源的柜内配线可按项目需求评审。以端子、套管与线材中各自限制定义组件边界。
text.en: For cabinet wiring near heat sources, review the project conditions. Define assembly boundaries from the separate limits of contacts, sleeves and wire.

text.zh: 按准确型号确认绝缘材料、导体镀层及文件。 材料最高温度不等于整条组件额定。
text.en: Confirm insulation, conductor plating and documents for the exact model. Maximum material temperature is not the full-assembly rating.

text.zh: 分别说明持续、短时及周围环境温度条件。 耐高温不自动意味着阻燃。
text.en: State continuous, short-duration and ambient temperature conditions separately. High-temperature resistance does not automatically mean flame retardance.

text.zh: 电压、热老化和化学暴露按实际项目审核。 热源距离和局部热点需实际评估。
text.en: Review voltage, thermal aging and chemical exposure for the actual project. Assess heat-source clearance and local hot spots.

value.en: Define assembly boundaries from the separate limits of contacts, sleeves and wire.

label.en: Installation and operating boundary

value.en: Provide the thermal map, current, route, connector drawings, material data and acceptance criteria.
value.zh: 请提供温度分布、电流、路径、接头图纸、材料数据及验收标准。

label.en: Sample and release basis

value.zh: 按获批图纸及项目特定的热工、电气检查放行完整组件。

question.zh: 材料最高温度等于组件额定吗？
question.en: Is the material maximum temperature the assembly rating?

answer.zh: 材料最高温度不等于整条组件额定。按准确型号确认绝缘材料、导体镀层及文件。
answer.en: Maximum material temperature is not the full-assembly rating. Confirm insulation, conductor plating and documents for the exact model.

question.zh: 耐高温线材是否一定阻燃？
question.en: Is high-temperature wire necessarily flame-retardant?

answer.zh: 耐高温不自动意味着阻燃。分别说明持续、短时及周围环境温度条件。
answer.en: High-temperature resistance does not automatically mean flame retardance. State continuous, short-duration and ambient temperature conditions separately.

question.zh: 标称温度能代替局部热点评估吗？
question.en: Can a nominal temperature replace local hot-spot review?

answer.zh: 热源距离和局部热点需实际评估。电压、热老化和化学暴露按实际项目审核。
answer.en: Assess heat-source clearance and local hot spots. Review voltage, thermal aging and chemical exposure for the actual project.
